metric.label: Lexical baseline
metric.description: Character n-gram cosine distance. This is a reproducible lexical baseline, not a semantic or faithfulness score.

units.leftText: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
units.rightText: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the wicked, Nor standeth in the way of sinners, Nor sitteth in the seat of scoffers:

units.leftText: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
units.rightText: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah; And on his law doth he meditate day and night.

units.leftText: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
units.rightText: And he shall be like a tree planted by the streams of water, That bringeth forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also doth not wither; And whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

units.leftText: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
units.rightText: The wicked are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

units.leftText: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
units.rightText: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

units.leftText: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
units.rightText: For Jehovah knoweth the way of the righteous; But the way of the wicked shall perish.

units.leftText: Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?
units.rightText: Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?
leftNotes: 2:1 Or noisily assemble; see Revelation 11:18|REV 11:18*.

units.leftText: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:
units.rightText: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, saying,
leftNotes: 2:2 Cited in Acts 4:25–26|ACT 4:25-26*

units.leftText: “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”
units.rightText: Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.

units.leftText: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord taunts them.
units.rightText: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.

units.leftText: Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:
units.rightText: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:

units.leftText: “I have installed My King on Zion, upon My holy mountain.”
units.rightText: Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.

units.leftText: I will proclaim the decree spoken to Me by the LORD: “You are My Son; today I have become Your Father.
units.rightText: I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.
leftNotes: 2:7 Literally today I have begotten You; cited in Acts 13:33|ACT 13:33*, Hebrews 1:5, and Hebrews 5:5

units.leftText: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
units.rightText: Ask of me, and I will give thee the nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

units.leftText: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery. ”
units.rightText: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
leftNotes: 2:9 LXX You will rule them or You will shepherd them
2:9 Cited in Revelation 2:27|REV 2:27*; see also Revelation 12:5 and Revelation 19:15.

units.leftText: Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.
units.rightText: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

units.leftText: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
units.rightText: Serve Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

units.leftText: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
units.rightText: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
units.rightText: Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased! Many are they that rise up against me.

units.leftText: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
units.rightText: Many there are that say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. [Selah*
leftNotes: 3:2 Selah or Interlude is probably a musical or literary term; here and throughout the Psalms.

units.leftText: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
units.rightText: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me; My glory, and the lifter up of my head.

units.leftText: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
units.rightText: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice, And he answereth me out of his holy hill. [Selah*

units.leftText: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
units.rightText: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Jehovah sustaineth me.

units.leftText: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
units.rightText: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about.

units.leftText: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
units.rightText: Arise, O Jehovah; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.

units.leftText: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah
units.rightText: Salvation belongeth unto Jehovah: Thy blessing be upon thy people. [Selah*

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
units.rightText: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness; Thou hast set me at large when I was in distress: Have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

units.leftText: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies ? Selah
units.rightText: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? How long will ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? [Selah*
leftNotes: 4:2 Or false gods

units.leftText: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
units.rightText: But know that Jehovah hath set apart for himself him that is godly: Jehovah will hear when I call unto him.

units.leftText: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
units.rightText: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. [Selah*
leftNotes: 4:4 Or In your anger do not sin or Tremble and do not sin; cited in Ephesians 4:26|EPH 4:26*

units.leftText: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
units.rightText: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in Jehovah.

units.leftText: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
units.rightText: Many there are that say, Who will show us any good? Jehovah, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.

units.leftText: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
units.rightText: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, More than they have when their grain and their new wine are increased.

units.leftText: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
units.rightText: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; For thou, Jehovah, alone makest me dwell in safety.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.
units.rightText: Give ear to my words, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.

units.leftText: Attend to the sound of my cry, my King and my God, for to You I pray.
units.rightText: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto thee do I pray.

units.leftText: In the morning, O LORD, You hear my voice; at daybreak I lay my plea before You and wait in expectation.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto thee, and will keep watch.

units.leftText: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
units.rightText: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Evil shall not sojourn with thee.

units.leftText: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
units.rightText: The arrogant shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

units.leftText: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
units.rightText: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth the blood-thirsty and deceitful man.

units.leftText: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
units.rightText: But as for me, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness will I come into thy house: In thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
leftNotes: 5:7 Forms of the Hebrew chesed are translated here and in most cases throughout the Scriptures as loving devotion; the range of meaning includes love, goodness, kindness, faithfulness, and mercy, as well as loyalty to a covenant.

units.leftText: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
units.rightText: Lead me, O Jehovah, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.

units.leftText: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
units.rightText: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.
leftNotes: 5:9 Or flattery; cited in Romans 3:13|ROM 3:13*

units.leftText: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.
units.rightText: Hold them guilty, O God; Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against thee.

units.leftText: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
units.rightText: But let all those that take refuge in thee rejoice, Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

units.leftText: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
units.rightText: For thou wilt bless the righteous; O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thine anger, Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
leftNotes: 6:1 Sheminithis probably a musical term; here and in 1 Chronicles 15:21|1CH 15:21* and Psalm 12:1.

units.leftText: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
units.rightText: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; for I am withered away: O Jehovah, heal me; for my bones are troubled.

units.leftText: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?
units.rightText: My soul also is sore troubled: And thou, O Jehovah, how long?

units.leftText: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
units.rightText: Return, O Jehovah, deliver my soul: Save me for thy lovingkindness’ sake.

units.leftText: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
units.rightText: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: In Sheol who shall give thee thanks?

units.leftText: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
units.rightText: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

units.leftText: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
units.rightText: Mine eye wasteth away because of grief; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.

units.leftText: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
units.rightText: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For Jehovah hath heard the voice of my weeping.

units.leftText: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath heard my supplication; Jehovah will receive my prayer.

units.leftText: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
units.rightText: All mine enemies shall be put to shame and sore troubled: They shall turn back, they shall be put to shame suddenly.

units.leftText: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite. O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,
units.rightText: O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge: Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,
leftNotes: 7:1 Shiggaion is probably a musical or liturgical term.

units.leftText: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
units.rightText: Lest they tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

units.leftText: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,
units.rightText: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;

units.leftText: if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,
units.rightText: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause was mine adversary);
leftNotes: 7:4 Hebrew the one at peace with me

units.leftText: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah
units.rightText: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; Yea, let him tread my life down to the earth, And lay my glory in the dust. [Selah*

units.leftText: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
units.rightText: Arise, O Jehovah, in thine anger; Lift up thyself against the rage of mine adversaries, And awake for me; thou hast commanded judgment.

units.leftText: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.
units.rightText: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about; And over them return thou on high.

units.leftText: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
units.rightText: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples: Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.

units.leftText: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
units.rightText: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous: For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.
leftNotes: 7:9 Hebrew hearts and kidneys

units.leftText: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
units.rightText: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.

units.leftText: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.
units.rightText: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.

units.leftText: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
units.rightText: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready;

units.leftText: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
units.rightText: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He maketh his arrows fiery shafts.

units.leftText: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
units.rightText: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

units.leftText: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
units.rightText: He hath made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.

units.leftText: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
units.rightText: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.

units.leftText: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
units.rightText: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth, Who hast set thy glory upon the heavens!
leftNotes: 8:1 Gittith is probably a musical or liturgical term; here and in Psalms 81 and 84.

units.leftText: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
units.rightText: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou established strength, Because of thine adversaries, That thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
leftNotes: 8:2 Literally You have ordained strength; LXX You have prepared praise; cited in Matthew 21:16|MAT 21:16*

units.leftText: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place —
units.rightText: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

units.leftText: what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
units.rightText: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that thou visitest him?

units.leftText: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
units.rightText: For thou hast made him but little lower than God, And crownest him with glory and honor.
leftNotes: 8:5 Or than God or than the heavenly beings; see also LXX.

units.leftText: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
units.rightText: Thou makest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; Thou hast put all things under his feet:
leftNotes: 8:6 Cited in 1 Corinthians 15:27|1CO 15:27* and Hebrews 2:6–8

units.leftText: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
units.rightText: All sheep and oxen, Yea, and the beasts of the field,

units.leftText: the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
units.rightText: The birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

units.leftText: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
units.rightText: O Jehovah, our Lord, How excellent is thy name in all the earth!

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
units.rightText: I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart; I will show forth all thy marvellous works.
leftNotes: 9:1 Psalms 9 and 10 together follow an acrostic pattern, each stanza beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet. In the LXX they form one psalm.

units.leftText: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
units.rightText: I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.

units.leftText: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
units.rightText: When mine enemies turn back, They stumble and perish at thy presence.

units.leftText: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
units.rightText: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sittest in the throne judging righteously.

units.leftText: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.
units.rightText: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

units.leftText: The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.
units.rightText: The enemy are come to an end, they are desolate for ever; And the cities which thou hast overthrown, The very remembrance of them is perished.

units.leftText: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
units.rightText: But Jehovah sitteth as king for ever: He hath prepared his throne for judgment;

units.leftText: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
units.rightText: And he will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

units.leftText: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
units.rightText: Jehovah also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;

units.leftText: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
units.rightText: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee; For thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

units.leftText: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
units.rightText: Sing praises to Jehovah, who dwelleth in Zion: Declare among the people his doings.

units.leftText: For the Avenger of bloodshed remembers; He does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.
units.rightText: For he that maketh inquisition for blood remembereth them; He forgetteth not the cry of the poor.

units.leftText: Be merciful to me, O LORD; see how my enemies afflict me! Lift me up from the gates of death,
units.rightText: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah; Behold my affliction which I suffer of them that hate me, Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;

units.leftText: that I may declare all Your praises — that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
units.rightText: That I may show forth all thy praise. In the gates of the daughter of Zion I will rejoice in thy salvation.

units.leftText: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
units.rightText: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

units.leftText: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah
units.rightText: Jehovah hath made himself known, he hath executed judgment: The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. [Higgaion. Selah*
leftNotes: 9:16 Higgaion Selah or quiet interlude is probably a musical or liturgical term.

units.leftText: The wicked will return to Sheol— all the nations who forget God.
units.rightText: The wicked shall be turned back unto Sheol, Even all the nations that forget God.

units.leftText: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.
units.rightText: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.

units.leftText: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
units.rightText: Arise, O Jehovah; let not man prevail: Let the nations be judged in thy sight.

units.leftText: Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah
units.rightText: Put them in fear, O Jehovah: Let the nations know themselves to be but men. [Selah*

units.leftText: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
units.rightText: Why standest thou afar off, O Jehovah? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

units.leftText: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
units.rightText: In the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued; Let them be taken in the devices that they have conceived.

units.leftText: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
units.rightText: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, And the covetous renounceth, yea, contemneth Jehovah.

units.leftText: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
units.rightText: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance, saith, He will not require it. All his thoughts are, There is no God.

units.leftText: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.
units.rightText: His ways are firm at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.

units.leftText: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”
units.rightText: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; To all generations I shall not be in adversity.

units.leftText: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
units.rightText: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression: Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
leftNotes: 10:7 LXX bitterness; cited in Romans 3:14|ROM 3:14*

units.leftText: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.
units.rightText: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In the secret places doth he murder the innocent; His eyes are privily set against the helpless.

units.leftText: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
units.rightText: He lurketh in secret as a lion in his covert; He lieth in wait to catch the poor: He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him in his net.

units.leftText: They are crushed and beaten down; the helpless fall prey to his strength.
units.rightText: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall by his strong ones.
leftNotes: 10:10 Or He crouches and lies low

units.leftText: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
units.rightText: He saith in his heart: God hath forgotten; He hideth his face, he will never see it.

units.leftText: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
units.rightText: Arise, O Jehovah; O God, lift up thy hand: Forget not the poor.

units.leftText: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”
units.rightText: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart, Thou wilt not require it?

units.leftText: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
units.rightText: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: The helpless committeth himself unto thee; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.

units.leftText: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
units.rightText: Break thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

units.leftText: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
units.rightText: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: The nations are perished out of his land.

units.leftText: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
units.rightText: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek: Thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear;

units.leftText: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.
units.rightText: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!
units.rightText: In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain;

units.leftText: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
units.rightText: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;

units.leftText: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”
units.rightText: If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?

units.leftText: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.
units.rightText: Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, his throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

units.leftText: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
units.rightText: Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

units.leftText: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.
units.rightText: Upon the wicked he will rain snares; Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.

units.leftText: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
units.rightText: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
units.rightText: Help, Jehovah; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
leftNotes: 12:1 Sheminithis probably a musical term; here and in 1 Chronicles 15:21|1CH 15:21* and Psalm 6:1.

units.leftText: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
units.rightText: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbor: With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.

units.leftText: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.
units.rightText: Jehovah will cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh great things;

units.leftText: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips— who can be our master?”
units.rightText: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; Our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

units.leftText: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
units.rightText: Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise, saith Jehovah; I will set him in the safety he panteth for.

units.leftText: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
units.rightText: The words of Jehovah are pure words; As silver tried in a furnace on the earth, Purified seven times.
leftNotes: 12:6 Probable reading; MT like silver refined in a furnace of clay, purified sevenfold

units.leftText: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.
units.rightText: Thou wilt keep them, O Jehovah, Thou wilt preserve them from this generation for ever.

units.leftText: The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men.
units.rightText: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
units.rightText: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou forget me for ever? How long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

units.leftText: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?
units.rightText: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart all the day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

units.leftText: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
units.rightText: Consider and answer me, O Jehovah my God: Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

units.leftText: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.
units.rightText: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; Lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.

units.leftText: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
units.rightText: But I have trusted in thy lovingkindness; My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

units.leftText: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.
units.rightText: I will sing unto Jehovah, Because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. Of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their acts are vile. There is no one who does good.
units.rightText: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works; There is none that doeth good.
leftNotes: 14:1 The Hebrew words rendered fool throughout the Psalms denote one who is morally deficient.

units.leftText: The LORD looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
units.rightText: Jehovah looked down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any that did understand, That did seek after God.

units.leftText: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
units.rightText: They are all gone aside; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
leftNotes: 14:3 LXX worthless
14:3 Cited in Romans 3:10–12|ROM 3:10-12*

units.leftText: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
units.rightText: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And call not upon Jehovah?

units.leftText: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.
units.rightText: There were they in great fear; For God is in the generation of the righteous.

units.leftText: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.
units.rightText: Ye put to shame the counsel of the poor, Because Jehovah is his refuge.

units.leftText: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
units.rightText: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When Jehovah bringeth back the captivity of his people, Then shall Jacob rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David. O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
units.rightText: Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

units.leftText: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,
units.rightText: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart;

units.leftText: who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,
units.rightText: He that slandereth not with his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his friend, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbor;

units.leftText: who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath,
units.rightText: In whose eyes a reprobate is despised, But who honoreth them that fear Jehovah; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;

units.leftText: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
units.rightText: He that putteth not out his money to interest, Nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

units.leftText: A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
units.rightText: Preserve me, O God; for in thee do I take refuge.
leftNotes: 16:1 Miktam is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalm 16 and Psalms 56–60.

units.leftText: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
units.rightText: O my soul, thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.

units.leftText: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
units.rightText: As for the saints that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.

units.leftText: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
units.rightText: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that give gifts for another god: Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.

units.leftText: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
units.rightText: Jehovah is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: Thou maintainest my lot.

units.leftText: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
units.rightText: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.

units.leftText: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
units.rightText: I will bless Jehovah, who hath given me counsel; Yea, my heart instructeth me in the night seasons.
leftNotes: 16:7 Or my heart instructs me; Hebrew my kidneys instruct me

units.leftText: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
units.rightText: I have set Jehovah always before me: Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
leftNotes: 16:8 LXX I foresaw

units.leftText: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
units.rightText: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: My flesh also shall dwell in safety.
leftNotes: 16:9 LXX will dwell in hope

units.leftText: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
units.rightText: For thou wilt not leave my soul to Sheol; Neither wilt thou suffer thy holy one to see corruption.
leftNotes: 16:10 Cited in Acts 13:35|ACT 13:35*

units.leftText: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
units.rightText: Thou wilt show me the path of life: In thy presence is fulness of joy; In thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
leftNotes: 16:11 Cited in Acts 2:25–28|ACT 2:25-28*

units.leftText: A prayer of David. Hear, O LORD, my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer— it comes from lips free of deceit.
units.rightText: Hear the right, O Jehovah, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.

units.leftText: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.
units.rightText: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; Let thine eyes look upon equity.

units.leftText: You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
units.rightText: Thou hast proved my heart; thou hast visited me in the night; Thou hast tried me, and findest nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

units.leftText: As for the deeds of men — by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.
units.rightText: As for the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.

units.leftText: My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.
units.rightText: My steps have held fast to thy paths, My feet have not slipped.

units.leftText: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
units.rightText: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt answer me, O God: Incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

units.leftText: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
units.rightText: Show thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them that take refuge in thee From those that rise up against them.

units.leftText: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; hide me in the shadow of Your wings
units.rightText: Keep me as the apple of the eye; Hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
leftNotes: 17:8 Literally as the pupil, the daughter of

units.leftText: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.
units.rightText: From the wicked that oppress me, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.

units.leftText: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
units.rightText: They are inclosed in their own fat: With their mouth they speak proudly.

units.leftText: They have tracked us down, and now surround us; their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,
units.rightText: They have now compassed us in our steps; They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

units.leftText: like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.
units.rightText: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, And as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

units.leftText: Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,
units.rightText: Arise, O Jehovah, Confront him, cast him down: Deliver my soul from the wicked by thy sword;

units.leftText: from such men, O LORD, by Your hand— from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.
units.rightText: From men by thy hand, O Jehovah, From men of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly thou fillest with thy treasure: They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
leftNotes: 17:14 Or May what You have stored up for the wicked fill their bellies

units.leftText: As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
units.rightText: As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with beholding thy form.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.
units.rightText: I love thee, O Jehovah, my strength.

units.leftText: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
units.rightText: Jehovah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in whom I will take refuge; My shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

units.leftText: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
units.rightText: I will call upon Jehovah, who is worthy to be praised: So shall I be saved from mine enemies.

units.leftText: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
units.rightText: The cords of death compassed me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

units.leftText: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
units.rightText: The cords of Sheol were round about me; The snares of death came upon me.

units.leftText: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for His help reached His ears.
units.rightText: In my distress I called upon Jehovah, And cried unto my God: He heard my voice out of his temple, And my cry before him came into his ears.

units.leftText: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
units.rightText: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations also of the mountains quaked And were shaken, because he was wroth.

units.leftText: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
units.rightText: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, And fire out of his mouth devoured: Coals were kindled by it.

units.leftText: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
units.rightText: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; And thick darkness was under his feet.

units.leftText: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
units.rightText: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he soared upon the wings of the wind.

units.leftText: He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.
units.rightText: He made darkness his hiding-place, his pavilion round about him, Darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

units.leftText: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced — hailstones and coals of fire.
units.rightText: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, Hailstones and coals of fire.
leftNotes: 18:12 Or bolts of lightning; also in verse 13

units.leftText: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded — hailstones and coals of fire.
units.rightText: Jehovah also thundered in the heavens, And the Most High uttered his voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.
leftNotes: 18:13 Most Hebrew manuscripts; some Hebrew manuscripts and LXX do not include —hailstones and coals of fire; see 2 Samuel 22:14|2SA 22:14*.

units.leftText: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
units.rightText: And he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yea, lightnings manifold, and discomfited them.

units.leftText: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
units.rightText: Then the channels of waters appeared, And the foundations of the world were laid bare, At thy rebuke, O Jehovah, At the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

units.leftText: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
units.rightText: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters.

units.leftText: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
units.rightText: He delivered me from my strong enemy, And from them that hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

units.leftText: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
units.rightText: They came upon me in the day of my calamity; But Jehovah was my stay.

units.leftText: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
units.rightText: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

units.leftText: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

units.leftText: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
units.rightText: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.

units.leftText: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
units.rightText: For all his ordinances were before me, And I put not away his statutes from me.

units.leftText: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
units.rightText: I was also perfect with him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.

units.leftText: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
units.rightText: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

units.leftText: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
units.rightText: With the merciful thou wilt show thyself merciful; With the perfect man thou wilt show thyself perfect;

units.leftText: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
units.rightText: With the pure thou wilt show thyself pure; And with the perverse thou wilt show thyself froward.

units.leftText: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
units.rightText: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; But the haughty eyes thou wilt bring down.

units.leftText: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
units.rightText: For thou wilt light my lamp: Jehovah my God will lighten my darkness.

units.leftText: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
units.rightText: For by thee I run upon a troop; And by my God do I leap over a wall.

units.leftText: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
units.rightText: As for God, his way is perfect: The word of Jehovah is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in him.

units.leftText: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
units.rightText: For who is God, save Jehovah? And who is a rock, besides our God,

units.leftText: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
units.rightText: The God that girdeth me with strength, And maketh my way perfect?

units.leftText: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
units.rightText: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: And setteth me upon my high places.

units.leftText: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
units.rightText: He teacheth my hands to war; So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.

units.leftText: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
units.rightText: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation; And thy right hand hath holden me up, And thy gentleness hath made me great.
leftNotes: 18:35 Or and Your help exalts me or and You stoop down to make me great

units.leftText: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
units.rightText: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.

units.leftText: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
units.rightText: I will pursue mine enemies, and overtake them; Neither will I turn again till they are consumed.

units.leftText: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
units.rightText: I will smite them through, so that they shall not be able to rise: They shall fall under my feet.

units.leftText: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
units.rightText: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

units.leftText: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.
units.rightText: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.

units.leftText: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them — to the LORD, but He did not answer.
units.rightText: They cried, but there was none to save; Even unto Jehovah, but he answered them not.

units.leftText: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
units.rightText: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.
leftNotes: 18:42 Some Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Syriac (see also 2 Samuel 22:43|2SA 22:43*); MT I poured them out

units.leftText: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
units.rightText: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; Thou hast made me the head of the nations: A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

units.leftText: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
units.rightText: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me; The foreigners shall submit themselves unto me.

units.leftText: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
units.rightText: The foreigners shall fade away, And shall come trembling out of their close places.

units.leftText: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
units.rightText: Jehovah liveth; and blessed be my rock; And exalted be the God of my salvation,

units.leftText: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,
units.rightText: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, And subdueth peoples under me.

units.leftText: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
units.rightText: He rescueth me from mine enemies; Yea, thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.

units.leftText: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
units.rightText: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the nations, And will sing praises unto thy name.
leftNotes: 18:49 Cited in Romans 15:9|ROM 15:9*

units.leftText: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
units.rightText: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
units.rightText: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament showeth his handiwork.

units.leftText: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
units.rightText: Day unto day uttereth speech, And night unto night showeth knowledge.

units.leftText: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
units.rightText: There is no speech nor language; Their voice is not heard.
leftNotes: 19:3 Or There is no speech or language where their voice is not heard

units.leftText: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
units.rightText: Their line is gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
leftNotes: 19:4 LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate; Hebrew their measuring line
19:4 Cited in Romans 10:18|ROM 10:18*

units.leftText: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
units.rightText: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.

units.leftText: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
units.rightText: His going forth is from the end of the heavens, And his circuit unto the ends of it; And there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

units.leftText: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
units.rightText: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.

units.leftText: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
units.rightText: The precepts of Jehovah are right, rejoicing the heart: The commandment of Jehovah is pure, enlightening the eyes.

units.leftText: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
units.rightText: The fear of Jehovah is clean, enduring for ever: The ordinances of Jehovah are true, and righteous altogether.

units.leftText: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
units.rightText: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the droppings of the honeycomb.

units.leftText: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.
units.rightText: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: In keeping them there is great reward.

units.leftText: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
units.rightText: Who can discern his errors? Clear thou me from hidden faults.

units.leftText: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
units.rightText: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me: Then shall I be upright, And I shall be clear from great transgression.

units.leftText: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
units.rightText: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in thy sight, O Jehovah, my rock, and my redeemer.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
units.rightText: Jehovah answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;

units.leftText: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
units.rightText: Send thee help from the sanctuary, And strengthen thee out of Zion;

units.leftText: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
units.rightText: Remember all thy offerings, And accept thy burnt-sacrifice; [Selah*

units.leftText: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
units.rightText: Grant thee thy heart’s desire, And fulfil all thy counsel.

units.leftText: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
units.rightText: We will triumph in thy salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Jehovah fulfil all thy petitions.

units.leftText: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
units.rightText: Now know I that Jehovah saveth his anointed; He will answer him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.

units.leftText: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
units.rightText: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Jehovah our God.

units.leftText: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
units.rightText: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.

units.leftText: O LORD, save the king. Answer us on the day we call.
units.rightText: Save, Jehovah: Let the King answer us when we call.
leftNotes: 20:9 Or give victory to

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
units.rightText: The king shall joy in thy strength, O Jehovah; And in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

units.leftText: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
units.rightText: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, And hast not withholden the request of his lips. [Selah*

units.leftText: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
units.rightText: For thou meetest him with the blessings of goodness: Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.

units.leftText: He asked You for life, and You granted it— length of days, forever and ever.
units.rightText: He asked life of thee, thou gavest it him, Even length of days for ever and ever.

units.leftText: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
units.rightText: His glory is great in thy salvation: Honor and majesty dost thou lay upon him.

units.leftText: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
units.rightText: For thou makest him most blessed for ever: Thou makest him glad with joy in thy presence.

units.leftText: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
units.rightText: For the king trusteth in Jehovah; And through the lovingkindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

units.leftText: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
units.rightText: Thy hand will find out all thine enemies; Thy right hand will find out those that hate thee.

units.leftText: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
units.rightText: Thou wilt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger: Jehovah will swallow them up in his wrath, And the fire shall devour them.

units.leftText: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
units.rightText: Their fruit wilt thou destroy from the earth, And their seed from among the children of men.

units.leftText: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
units.rightText: For they intended evil against thee; They conceived a device which they are not able to perform.

units.leftText: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
units.rightText: For thou wilt make them turn their back; Thou wilt make ready with thy bowstrings against their face.

units.leftText: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
units.rightText: Be thou exalted, O Jehovah, in thy strength: So will we sing and praise thy power.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?
units.rightText: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? Why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
leftNotes: 22:1 Cited in Matthew 27:46|MAT 27:46* and Mark 15:34

units.leftText: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
units.rightText: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou answerest not; And in the night season, and am not silent.

units.leftText: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
units.rightText: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

units.leftText: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
units.rightText: Our fathers trusted in thee: They trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

units.leftText: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
units.rightText: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: They trusted in thee, and were not put to shame.

units.leftText: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.
units.rightText: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised of the people.

units.leftText: All who see me mock me; they sneer and shake their heads:
units.rightText: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

units.leftText: “He trusts in the LORD, let the LORD deliver him; let the LORD rescue him, since He delights in him.”
units.rightText: Commit thyself unto Jehovah; let him deliver him: Let him rescue him, seeing he delighteth in him.
leftNotes: 22:8 Cited in Matthew 27:43|MAT 27:43*

units.leftText: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.
units.rightText: But thou art he that took me out of the womb; Thou didst make me trust when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

units.leftText: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
units.rightText: I was cast upon thee from the womb; Thou art my God since my mother bare me.

units.leftText: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
units.rightText: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; For there is none to help.

units.leftText: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
units.rightText: Many bulls have compassed me; Strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

units.leftText: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
units.rightText: They gape upon me with their mouth, As a ravening and a roaring lion.

units.leftText: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are disjointed. My heart is like wax; it melts away within me.
units.rightText: I am poured out like water, And all my bones are out of joint: My heart is like wax; It is melted within me.

units.leftText: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You lay me in the dust of death.
units.rightText: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; And my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; And thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
leftNotes: 22:15 MT; or My mouth, a possible reading of the original Hebrew text

units.leftText: For dogs surround me; a band of evil men encircles me; they have pierced my hands and feet.
units.rightText: For dogs have compassed me: A company of evil-doers have inclosed me; They pierced my hands and my feet.
leftNotes: 22:16 DSS, LXX, Vulgate, and Syriac; most MT like a lion at my hands and feet

units.leftText: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
units.rightText: I may count all my bones. They look and stare upon me;

units.leftText: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.
units.rightText: They part my garments among them, And upon my vesture do they cast lots.
leftNotes: 22:18 Cited in John 19:24|JHN 19:24*; see also Matthew 27:35, Mark 15:24, and Luke 23:34

units.leftText: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
units.rightText: But be not thou far off, O Jehovah: O thou my succor, haste thee to help me.

units.leftText: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
units.rightText: Deliver my soul from the sword, My darling from the power of the dog.

units.leftText: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!
units.rightText: Save me from the lion’s mouth; Yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen thou hast answered me.

units.leftText: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
units.rightText: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: In the midst of the assembly will I praise thee.
leftNotes: 22:22 LXX I will sing Your praises in the assembly; cited in Hebrews 2:12|HEB 2:12*.

units.leftText: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!
units.rightText: Ye that fear Jehovah, praise him; All ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; And stand in awe of him, all ye the seed of Israel.

units.leftText: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
units.rightText: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Neither hath he hid his face from him; But when he cried unto him, he heard.

units.leftText: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
units.rightText: Of thee cometh my praise in the great assembly: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

units.leftText: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
units.rightText: The meek shall eat and be satisfied; They shall praise Jehovah that seek after him: Let your heart live for ever.

units.leftText: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
units.rightText: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto Jehovah; And all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

units.leftText: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.
units.rightText: For the kingdom is Jehovah’s; And he is the ruler over the nations.

units.leftText: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him— even those unable to preserve their lives.
units.rightText: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship: All they that go down to the dust shall bow before him, Even he that cannot keep his soul alive.

units.leftText: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
units.rightText: A seed shall serve him; It shall be told of the Lord unto the next generation.

units.leftText: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn — all that He has done.
units.rightText: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done it.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
units.rightText: Jehovah is my shepherd; I shall not want.
leftNotes: 23:1 See Revelation 7:17|REV 7:17*.

units.leftText: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
units.rightText: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside still waters.

units.leftText: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
units.rightText: He restoreth my soul: He guideth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

units.leftText: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
units.rightText: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; for thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me.
leftNotes: 23:4 Or the valley of deep darkness

units.leftText: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.
units.rightText: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: Thou hast anointed my head with oil; My cup runneth over.

units.leftText: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
units.rightText: Surely goodness and lovingkindness shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of Jehovah for ever.
leftNotes: 23:6 Literally for a length of days

units.leftText: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
units.rightText: The earth is Jehovah’s, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.
leftNotes: 24:1 Cited in 1 Corinthians 10:26|1CO 10:26*

units.leftText: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
units.rightText: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.

units.leftText: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
units.rightText: Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?

units.leftText: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
units.rightText: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully.
leftNotes: 24:4 Or to falsehood or to vanity

units.leftText: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
units.rightText: He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

units.leftText: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
units.rightText: This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, even Jacob. [Selah*
leftNotes: 24:6 LXX, Syriac, and two Hebrew manuscripts; MT who seek your face, O Jacob

units.leftText: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
units.rightText: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

units.leftText: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
units.rightText: Who is the King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.

units.leftText: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
units.rightText: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

units.leftText: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts — He is the King of Glory. Selah
units.rightText: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, He is the King of glory. [Selah*

units.leftText: Of David. To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;
units.rightText: Unto thee, O Jehovah, do I lift up my soul.
leftNotes: 25:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each verse beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
units.rightText: O my God, in thee have I trusted, Let me not be put to shame; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.

units.leftText: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced.
units.rightText: Yea, none that wait for thee shall be put to shame: They shall be put to shame that deal treacherously without cause.

units.leftText: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
units.rightText: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.

units.leftText: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
units.rightText: Guide me in thy truth, and teach me; For thou art the God of my salvation; For thee do I wait all the day.

units.leftText: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
units.rightText: Remember, O Jehovah, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindness; For they have been ever of old.

units.leftText: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
units.rightText: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: According to thy lovingkindness remember thou me, For thy goodness’ sake, O Jehovah.

units.leftText: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
units.rightText: Good and upright is Jehovah: Therefore will he instruct sinners in the way.

units.leftText: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
units.rightText: The meek will he guide in justice; And the meek will he teach his way.

units.leftText: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
units.rightText: All the paths of Jehovah are lovingkindness and truth Unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

units.leftText: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
units.rightText: For thy name’s sake, O Jehovah, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.

units.leftText: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
units.rightText: What man is he that feareth Jehovah? Him shall he instruct in the way that he shall choose.

units.leftText: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
units.rightText: His soul shall dwell at ease; And his seed shall inherit the land.

units.leftText: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
units.rightText: The friendship of Jehovah is with them that fear him; And he will show them his covenant.

units.leftText: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
units.rightText: Mine eyes are ever toward Jehovah; For he will pluck my feet out of the net.

units.leftText: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
units.rightText: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; For I am desolate and afflicted.

units.leftText: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
units.rightText: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: Oh bring thou me out of my distresses.

units.leftText: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
units.rightText: Consider mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.

units.leftText: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
units.rightText: Consider mine enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.

units.leftText: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
units.rightText: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me: Let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in thee.

units.leftText: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
units.rightText: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for thee.
leftNotes: 25:21 Or because my hope is in You; LXX because I wait for You, O Lord

units.leftText: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.
units.rightText: Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all his troubles.

units.leftText: Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
units.rightText: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in Jehovah without wavering.

units.leftText: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
units.rightText: Examine me, O Jehovah, and prove me; Try my heart and my mind.
leftNotes: 26:2 Hebrew my kidneys

units.leftText: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
units.rightText: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes; And I have walked in thy truth.

units.leftText: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
units.rightText: I have not sat with men of falsehood; Neither will I go in with dissemblers.

units.leftText: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
units.rightText: I hate the assembly of evil-doers, And will not sit with the wicked.
