units.leftText: I wash my hands in innocence that I may go about Your altar, O LORD,
units.rightText: I will wash my hands in innocency: So will I compass thine altar, O Jehovah;

units.leftText: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.
units.rightText: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, And tell of all thy wondrous works.

units.leftText: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
units.rightText: Jehovah, I love the habitation of thy house, And the place where thy glory dwelleth.

units.leftText: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
units.rightText: Gather not my soul with sinners, Nor my life with men of blood;

units.leftText: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
units.rightText: In whose hands is wickedness, And their right hand is full of bribes.

units.leftText: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
units.rightText: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: Redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

units.leftText: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
units.rightText: My foot standeth in an even place: In the congregations will I bless Jehovah.

units.leftText: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
units.rightText: Jehovah is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? Jehovah is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?

units.leftText: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
units.rightText: When evil-doers came upon me to eat up my flesh, Even mine adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

units.leftText: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
units.rightText: Though a host should encamp against me, My heart shall not fear: Though war should rise against me, Even then will I be confident.

units.leftText: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
units.rightText: One thing have I asked of Jehovah, that will I seek after: That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the beauty of Jehovah, And to inquire in his temple.

units.leftText: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
units.rightText: For in the day of trouble he will keep me secretly in his pavilion: In the covert of his tabernacle will he hide me; He will lift me up upon a rock.

units.leftText: Then my head will be held high above my enemies around me. At His tabernacle I will offer sacrifices with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.
units.rightText: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me; And I will offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Hear, O LORD, my voice when I call; be merciful and answer me.
units.rightText: Hear, O Jehovah, when I cry with my voice: Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

units.leftText: My heart said, “Seek His face.” Your face, O LORD, I will seek.
units.rightText: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, Jehovah, will I seek.

units.leftText: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
units.rightText: Hide not thy face from me; Put not thy servant away in anger: Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

units.leftText: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.
units.rightText: When my father and my mother forsake me, Then Jehovah will take me up.

units.leftText: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
units.rightText: Teach me thy way, O Jehovah; And lead me in a plain path, Because of mine enemies.

units.leftText: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
units.rightText: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries: For false witnesses are risen up against me, And such as breathe out cruelty.

units.leftText: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
units.rightText: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of Jehovah In the land of the living.

units.leftText: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
units.rightText: Wait for Jehovah: Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for Jehovah.

units.leftText: Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
units.rightText: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

units.leftText: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.
units.rightText: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
leftNotes: 28:2 Or Your innermost sanctuary or Your Most Holy Place

units.leftText: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
units.rightText: Draw me not away with the wicked, And with the workers of iniquity; That speak peace with their neighbors, But mischief is in their hearts.

units.leftText: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.
units.rightText: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings: Give them after the operation of their hands; Render to them their desert.

units.leftText: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
units.rightText: Because they regard not the works of Jehovah, Nor the operation of his hands, He will break them down and not build them up.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah, Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

units.leftText: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
units.rightText: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.

units.leftText: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
units.rightText: Jehovah is their strength, And he is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

units.leftText: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
units.rightText: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
units.rightText: Ascribe unto Jehovah, O ye sons of the mighty, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.
leftNotes: 29:1 Or sons of God or sons of might

units.leftText: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
units.rightText: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name; Worship Jehovah in holy array.
leftNotes: 29:2 Or in holy attire

units.leftText: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
units.rightText: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth, Even Jehovah upon many waters.

units.leftText: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
units.rightText: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.

units.leftText: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
units.rightText: The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Yea, Jehovah breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

units.leftText: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
units.rightText: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.
leftNotes: 29:6 That is, Mount Hermon

units.leftText: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
units.rightText: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.

units.leftText: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
units.rightText: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

units.leftText: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
units.rightText: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare: And in his temple everything saith, Glory.
leftNotes: 29:9 Or LORD makes the deer to calve

units.leftText: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
units.rightText: Jehovah sat as King at the Flood; Yea, Jehovah sitteth as King for ever.

units.leftText: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
units.rightText: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.

units.leftText: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
units.rightText: I will extol thee, O Jehovah; for thou hast raised me up, And hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

units.leftText: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
units.rightText: O Jehovah my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

units.leftText: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, thou hast brought up my soul from Sheol; Thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
units.rightText: Sing praise unto Jehovah, O ye saints of his, And give thanks to his holy memorial name.
leftNotes: 30:4 Or and praise the memorial of His holiness; see Exodus 3:15|EXO 3:15*.

units.leftText: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
units.rightText: For his anger is but for a moment; His favor is for a life-time: Weeping may tarry for the night, But joy cometh in the morning.

units.leftText: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
units.rightText: As for me, I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved.

units.leftText: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
units.rightText: Thou, Jehovah, of thy favor hadst made my mountain to stand strong: Thou didst hide thy face; I was troubled.

units.leftText: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
units.rightText: I cried to thee, O Jehovah; And unto Jehovah I made supplication:

units.leftText: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
units.rightText: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
leftNotes: 30:9 Or in my destruction
30:9 Or to corruption

units.leftText: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
units.rightText: Hear, O Jehovah, and have mercy upon me: Jehovah, be thou my helper.

units.leftText: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
units.rightText: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing; Thou hast loosed my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

units.leftText: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
units.rightText: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Jehovah my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
units.rightText: In thee, O Jehovah, do I take refuge; Let me never be put to shame: Deliver me in thy righteousness.

units.leftText: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
units.rightText: Bow down thine ear unto me; deliver me speedily: Be thou to me a strong rock, A house of defence to save me.

units.leftText: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
units.rightText: For thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for thy name’s sake lead me and guide me.

units.leftText: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
units.rightText: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid privily for me; For thou art my stronghold.

units.leftText: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
units.rightText: Into thy hand I commend my spirit: Thou hast redeemed me, O Jehovah, thou God of truth.
leftNotes: 31:5 Cited in Luke 23:46|LUK 23:46*

units.leftText: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
units.rightText: I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in Jehovah.
leftNotes: 31:6 MT; one Hebrew manuscript, LXX, and Syriac You hate

units.leftText: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
units.rightText: I will be glad and rejoice in thy lovingkindness; For thou hast seen my affliction: Thou hast known my soul in adversities;

units.leftText: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
units.rightText: And thou hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a large place.

units.leftText: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
units.rightText: Have mercy upon me, O Jehovah, for I am in distress: Mine eye wasteth away with grief, yea, my soul and my body.

units.leftText: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
units.rightText: For my life is spent with sorrow, And my years with sighing: My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, And my bones are wasted away.

units.leftText: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends — they flee when they see me on the street.
units.rightText: Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, Yea, unto my neighbors exceedingly, And a fear to mine acquaintance: They that did see me without fled from me.

units.leftText: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
units.rightText: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

units.leftText: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
units.rightText: For I have heard the defaming of many, Terror on every side: While they took counsel together against me, They devised to take away my life.

units.leftText: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
units.rightText: But I trusted in thee, O Jehovah: I said, Thou art my God.

units.leftText: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
units.rightText: My times are in thy hand: Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

units.leftText: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
units.rightText: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: Save me in thy lovingkindness.

units.leftText: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
units.rightText: Let me not be put to shame, O Jehovah; for I have called upon thee: Let the wicked be put to shame, let them be silent in Sheol.

units.leftText: May lying lips be silenced — lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
units.rightText: Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak against the righteous insolently, With pride and contempt.

units.leftText: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
units.rightText: Oh how great is thy goodness, Which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee, Which thou hast wrought for them that take refuge in thee, Before the sons of men!

units.leftText: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
units.rightText: In the covert of thy presence wilt thou hide them from the plottings of man: Thou wilt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah; For he hath showed me his marvellous lovingkindness in a strong city.

units.leftText: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
units.rightText: As for me, I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: Nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications, When I cried unto thee.

units.leftText: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
units.rightText: Oh love Jehovah, all ye his saints: Jehovah preserveth the faithful, And plentifully rewardeth him that dealeth proudly.

units.leftText: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
units.rightText: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that hope in Jehovah.

units.leftText: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
units.rightText: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.
leftNotes: 32:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.
32:1 LXX Blessed is he whose lawless acts are forgiven, whose sins are covered; cited in Romans 4:7|ROM 4:7*

units.leftText: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
units.rightText: Blessed is the man unto whom Jehovah imputeth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.
leftNotes: 32:2 LXX Blessed is the man whose sin the LORD does not count against him; cited in Romans 4:8|ROM 4:8*

units.leftText: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
units.rightText: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away Through my groaning all the day long.

units.leftText: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
units.rightText: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: My moisture was changed as with the drought of summer. [Selah*
leftNotes: 32:4 Or my vitality was turned

units.leftText: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
units.rightText: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, And mine iniquity did I not hide: I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Jehovah; And thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. [Selah*

units.leftText: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
units.rightText: For this let every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: Surely when the great waters overflow they shall not reach unto him.

units.leftText: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
units.rightText: Thou art my hiding-place; thou wilt preserve me from trouble; Thou wilt compass me about with songs of deliverance. [Selah*

units.leftText: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
units.rightText: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will counsel thee with mine eye upon thee.

units.leftText: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
units.rightText: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose trappings must be bit and bridle to hold them in, Else they will not come near unto thee.

units.leftText: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
units.rightText: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked; But he that trusteth in Jehovah, lovingkindness shall compass him about.

units.leftText: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
units.rightText: Be glad in Jehovah, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

units.leftText: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
units.rightText: Rejoice in Jehovah, O ye righteous: Praise is comely for the upright.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
units.rightText: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp: Sing praises unto him with the psaltery of ten strings.

units.leftText: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
units.rightText: Sing unto him a new song; Play skilfully with a loud noise.

units.leftText: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
units.rightText: For the word of Jehovah is right; And all his work is done in faithfulness.

units.leftText: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.
units.rightText: He loveth righteousness and justice: The earth is full of the lovingkindness of Jehovah.

units.leftText: By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, and all the stars by the breath of His mouth.
units.rightText: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, And all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

units.leftText: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
units.rightText: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap: He layeth up the deeps in store-houses.

units.leftText: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
units.rightText: Let all the earth fear Jehovah: Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

units.leftText: For He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood firm.
units.rightText: For he spake, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.

units.leftText: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
units.rightText: Jehovah bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

units.leftText: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
units.rightText: The counsel of Jehovah standeth fast for ever, The thoughts of his heart to all generations.

units.leftText: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
units.rightText: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

units.leftText: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
units.rightText: Jehovah looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;

units.leftText: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.
units.rightText: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth Upon all the inhabitants of the earth,

units.leftText: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.
units.rightText: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their works.

units.leftText: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
units.rightText: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

units.leftText: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
units.rightText: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth he deliver any by his great power.

units.leftText: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
units.rightText: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, Upon them that hope in his lovingkindness;

units.leftText: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
units.rightText: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.

units.leftText: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
units.rightText: Our soul hath waited for Jehovah: He is our help and our shield.

units.leftText: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
units.rightText: For our heart shall rejoice in him, Because we have trusted in his holy name.

units.leftText: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
units.rightText: Let thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, According as we have hoped in thee.

units.leftText: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
units.rightText: I will bless Jehovah at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
leftNotes: 34:1 Abimelech is another name for Achish; see 1 Samuel 21–29 and 1 Kings 2:39|1KI 2:39*.
34:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each verse beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
units.rightText: My soul shall make her boast in Jehovah: The meek shall hear thereof, and be glad.

units.leftText: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
units.rightText: Oh magnify Jehovah with me, And let us exalt his name together.

units.leftText: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
units.rightText: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.

units.leftText: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
units.rightText: They looked unto him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be confounded.

units.leftText: This poor man called out, and the LORD heard him; He saved him from all his troubles.
units.rightText: This poor man cried, and Jehovah heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.

units.leftText: The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear Him, and he delivers them.
units.rightText: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, And delivereth them.

units.leftText: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
units.rightText: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.

units.leftText: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
units.rightText: Oh fear Jehovah, ye his saints; For there is no want to them that fear him.

units.leftText: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
units.rightText: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good thing.

units.leftText: Come, children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
units.rightText: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
units.rightText: What man is he that desireth life, And loveth many days, that he may see good?

units.leftText: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
units.rightText: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.

units.leftText: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
units.rightText: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.

units.leftText: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, and His ears are inclined to their cry.
units.rightText: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous, And his ears are open unto their cry.
leftNotes: 34:15 LXX to their prayer

units.leftText: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
units.rightText: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

units.leftText: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
units.rightText: The righteous cried, and Jehovah heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.

units.leftText: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
units.rightText: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.

units.leftText: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
units.rightText: Many are the afflictions of the righteous; But Jehovah delivereth him out of them all.

units.leftText: He protects all his bones; not one of them will be broken.
units.rightText: He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken.
leftNotes: 34:20 Cited in John 19:36|JHN 19:36*

units.leftText: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
units.rightText: Evil shall slay the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.

units.leftText: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
units.rightText: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; And none of them that take refuge in him shall be condemned.

units.leftText: Of David. Contend with my opponents, O LORD; fight against those who fight against me.
units.rightText: Strive thou, O Jehovah, with them that strive with me: Fight thou against them that fight against me.

units.leftText: Take up Your shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
units.rightText: Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.

units.leftText: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
units.rightText: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that pursue me: Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
leftNotes: 35:3 Or and close the way

units.leftText: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
units.rightText: Let them be put to shame and brought to dishonor that seek after my soul: Let them be turned back and confounded that devise my hurt.

units.leftText: May they be like chaff in the wind, as the angel of the LORD drives them away.
units.rightText: Let them be as chaff before the wind, And the angel of Jehovah driving them on.

units.leftText: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.
units.rightText: Let their way be dark and slippery, And the angel of Jehovah pursuing them.

units.leftText: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
units.rightText: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit; Without cause have they digged a pit for my soul.

units.leftText: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
units.rightText: Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself: With destruction let him fall therein.

units.leftText: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
units.rightText: And my soul shall be joyful in Jehovah: It shall rejoice in his salvation.

units.leftText: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
units.rightText: All my bones shall say, Jehovah, who is like unto thee, Who deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that robbeth him?

units.leftText: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
units.rightText: Unrighteous witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I know not.

units.leftText: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
units.rightText: They reward me evil for good, To the bereaving of my soul.

units.leftText: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
units.rightText: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I afflicted my soul with fasting; And my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
leftNotes: 35:13 Literally returned to my bosom

units.leftText: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
units.rightText: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother: I bowed down mourning, as one that bewaileth his mother.

units.leftText: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
units.rightText: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: The abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; They did tear me, and ceased not:

units.leftText: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
units.rightText: Like the profane mockers in feasts, They gnashed upon me with their teeth.
leftNotes: 35:16 Or Like a godless circle of mockers,

units.leftText: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
units.rightText: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, My darling from the lions.

units.leftText: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
units.rightText: I will give thee thanks in the great assembly: I will praise thee among much people.

units.leftText: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
units.rightText: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

units.leftText: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
units.rightText: For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful words against them that are quiet in the land.

units.leftText: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
units.rightText: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me; They said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

units.leftText: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
units.rightText: Thou hast seen it, O Jehovah; keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

units.leftText: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
units.rightText: Stir up thyself, and awake to the justice due unto me, Even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

units.leftText: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
units.rightText: Judge me, O Jehovah my God, according to thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.

units.leftText: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
units.rightText: Let them not say in their heart, Aha, so would we have it: Let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

units.leftText: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
units.rightText: Let them be put to shame and confounded together that rejoice at my hurt: Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor that magnify themselves against me.

units.leftText: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
units.rightText: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favor my righteous cause: Yea, let them say continually, Jehovah be magnified, Who hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

units.leftText: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
units.rightText: And my tongue shall talk of thy righteousness And of thy praise all the day long.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
units.rightText: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, There is no fear of God before his eyes.
leftNotes: 36:1 Cited in Romans 3:18|ROM 3:18*

units.leftText: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
units.rightText: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, That his iniquity will not be found out and be hated.

units.leftText: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
units.rightText: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: He hath ceased to be wise and to do good.

units.leftText: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
units.rightText: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.

units.leftText: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
units.rightText: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness reacheth unto the skies.

units.leftText: Your righteousness is like the highest mountains; Your judgments are like the deepest sea. O LORD, You preserve man and beast.
units.rightText: Thy righteousness is like the mountains of God; Thy judgments are a great deep: O Jehovah, thou preservest man and beast.

units.leftText: How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
units.rightText: How precious is thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge under the shadow of thy wings.

units.leftText: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
units.rightText: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; And thou wilt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

units.leftText: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
units.rightText: For with thee is the fountain of life: In thy light shall we see light.

units.leftText: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
units.rightText: Oh continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee, And thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

units.leftText: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
units.rightText: Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

units.leftText: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
units.rightText: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

units.leftText: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
units.rightText: Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, Neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.
leftNotes: 37:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each stanza beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
units.rightText: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.

units.leftText: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
units.rightText: Trust in Jehovah, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on his faithfulness.

units.leftText: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
units.rightText: Delight thyself also in Jehovah; And he will give thee the desires of thy heart.

units.leftText: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
units.rightText: Commit thy way unto Jehovah; Trust also in him, and he will bring it to pass.

units.leftText: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
units.rightText: And he will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, And thy justice as the noonday.

units.leftText: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
units.rightText: Rest in Jehovah, and wait patiently for him: Fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, Because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

units.leftText: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret— it can only bring harm.
units.rightText: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: Fret not thyself, it tendeth only to evil-doing.

units.leftText: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
units.rightText: For evil-doers shall be cut off; But those that wait for Jehovah, they shall inherit the land.

units.leftText: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
units.rightText: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: Yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and he shall not be.

units.leftText: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
units.rightText: But the meek shall inherit the land, And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
leftNotes: 37:11 Or the earth; see Matthew 5:5|MAT 5:5*.

units.leftText: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
units.rightText: The wicked plotteth against the just, And gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

units.leftText: but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
units.rightText: The Lord will laugh at him; For he seeth that his day is coming.

units.leftText: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
units.rightText: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay such as are upright in the way.

units.leftText: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
units.rightText: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.

units.leftText: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
units.rightText: Better is a little that the righteous hath Than the abundance of many wicked.

units.leftText: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
units.rightText: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; But Jehovah upholdeth the righteous.

units.leftText: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
units.rightText: Jehovah knoweth the days of the perfect; And their inheritance shall be for ever.

units.leftText: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
units.rightText: They shall not be put to shame in the time of evil; And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

units.leftText: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
units.rightText: But the wicked shall perish, And the enemies of Jehovah shall be as the fat of lambs: They shall consume; in smoke shall they consume away.

units.leftText: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
units.rightText: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again; But the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.

units.leftText: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
units.rightText: For such as are blessed of him shall inherit the land; And they that are cursed of him shall be cut off.

units.leftText: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
units.rightText: A man’s goings are established of Jehovah; And he delighteth in his way.

units.leftText: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
units.rightText: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For Jehovah upholdeth him with his hand.
leftNotes: 37:24 Or upholds him with His hand

units.leftText: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
units.rightText: I have been young, and now am old; Yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his seed begging bread.

units.leftText: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
units.rightText: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; And his seed is blessed.

units.leftText: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
units.rightText: Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell for evermore.

units.leftText: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
units.rightText: For Jehovah loveth justice, And forsaketh not his saints; They are preserved for ever: But the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

units.leftText: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
units.rightText: The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell therein for ever.

units.leftText: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
units.rightText: The mouth of the righteous talketh of wisdom, And his tongue speaketh justice.

units.leftText: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
units.rightText: The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.

units.leftText: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,
units.rightText: The wicked watcheth the righteous, And seeketh to slay him.

units.leftText: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
units.rightText: Jehovah will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.

units.leftText: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
units.rightText: Wait for Jehovah, and keep his way, And he will exalt thee to inherit the land: When the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

units.leftText: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
units.rightText: I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

units.leftText: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
units.rightText: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not: Yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

units.leftText: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
units.rightText: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright; For there is a happy end to the man of peace.
leftNotes: 37:37 Or for there is a future for the man of peace

units.leftText: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
units.rightText: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together: The end of the wicked shall be cut off.

units.leftText: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
units.rightText: But the salvation of the righteous is of Jehovah: He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

units.leftText: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.
units.rightText: And Jehovah helpeth them, and rescueth them: He rescueth them from the wicked, and saveth them, Because they have taken refuge in him.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

units.leftText: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
units.rightText: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.

units.leftText: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
units.rightText: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

units.leftText: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
units.rightText: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

units.leftText: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.
units.rightText: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, Because of my foolishness.

units.leftText: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
units.rightText: I am pained and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

units.leftText: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
units.rightText: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.

units.leftText: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
units.rightText: I am faint and sore bruised: I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

units.leftText: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
units.rightText: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.

units.leftText: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
units.rightText: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

units.leftText: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
units.rightText: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.

units.leftText: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
units.rightText: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And meditate deceits all the day long.

units.leftText: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
units.rightText: But I, as a deaf man, hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

units.leftText: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
units.rightText: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.

units.leftText: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
units.rightText: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope: Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.

units.leftText: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me — those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
units.rightText: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

units.leftText: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
units.rightText: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.

units.leftText: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
units.rightText: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

units.leftText: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
units.rightText: But mine enemies are lively, and are strong; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
leftNotes: 38:19 One DSS manuscript; MT My enemies are vigorous and strong

units.leftText: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
units.rightText: They also that render evil for good Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.

units.leftText: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
units.rightText: Forsake me not, O Jehovah: O my God, be not far from me.

units.leftText: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
units.rightText: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”
units.rightText: I said, I will take heed to my ways, That I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, While the wicked is before me.

units.leftText: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.
units.rightText: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; And my sorrow was stirred.

units.leftText: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
units.rightText: My heart was hot within me; While I was musing the fire burned; Then spake I with my tongue:

units.leftText: “Show me, O LORD, my end and the measure of my days. Let me know how fleeting my life is.
units.rightText: Jehovah, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how frail I am.

units.leftText: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
units.rightText: Behold, thou hast made my days as handbreadths; And my life-time is as nothing before thee: Surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. [Selah*

units.leftText: Surely every man goes about like a phantom; surely he bustles in vain; he heaps up riches not knowing who will haul them away.
units.rightText: Surely every man walketh in a vain show; Surely they are disquieted in vain: He heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

units.leftText: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
units.rightText: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope is in thee.

units.leftText: Deliver me from all my transgressions; do not make me the reproach of fools.
units.rightText: Deliver me from all my transgressions: Make me not the reproach of the foolish.

units.leftText: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.
units.rightText: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; Because thou didst it.

units.leftText: Remove Your scourge from me; I am perishing by the force of Your hand.
units.rightText: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thy hand.

units.leftText: You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah
units.rightText: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, Thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: Surely every man is vanity. [Selah*

units.leftText: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear to my cry for help; do not be deaf to my weeping. For I am a foreigner dwelling with You, a stranger like all my fathers.
units.rightText: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, and give ear unto my cry; Hold not thy peace at my tears: For I am a stranger with thee, A sojourner, as all my fathers were.

units.leftText: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”
units.rightText: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, Before I go hence, and be no more.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
units.rightText: I waited patiently for Jehovah; And he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

units.leftText: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
units.rightText: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay; And he set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

units.leftText: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
units.rightText: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: Many shall see it, and fear, And shall trust in Jehovah.

units.leftText: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
units.rightText: Blessed is the man that maketh Jehovah his trust, And respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
leftNotes: 40:4 Or who turn aside to false gods or who run after lies

units.leftText: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us — none can compare to You — if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
units.rightText: Many, O Jehovah my God, are the wonderful works which thou hast done, And thy thoughts which are to us-ward: They cannot be set in order unto thee; If I would declare and speak of them, They are more than can be numbered.

units.leftText: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
units.rightText: Sacrifice and offering thou hast no delight in; Mine ears hast thou opened: Burnt-offering and sin-offering hast thou not required.
leftNotes: 40:6 Hebrew; some LXX manuscripts but a body You prepared for me

units.leftText: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come — it is written about me in the scroll:
units.rightText: Then said I, Lo, I am come; In the roll of the book it is written of me:

units.leftText: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
units.rightText: I delight to do thy will, O my God; Yea, thy law is within my heart.
leftNotes: 40:8 Cited in Hebrews 10:5–7|HEB 10:5-7*

units.leftText: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.
units.rightText: I have proclaimed glad tidings of righteousness in the great assembly; Lo, I will not refrain my lips, O Jehovah, thou knowest.

units.leftText: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
units.rightText: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation; I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great assembly.

units.leftText: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
units.rightText: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Jehovah; Let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

units.leftText: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.
units.rightText: For innumerable evils have compassed me about; Mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; And my heart hath failed me.

units.leftText: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
units.rightText: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me: Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

units.leftText: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
units.rightText: Let them be put to shame and confounded together That seek after my soul to destroy it: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.

units.leftText: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
units.rightText: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame That say unto me, Aha, aha.

units.leftText: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
units.rightText: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: Let such as love thy salvation say continually, Jehovah be magnified.

units.leftText: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
units.rightText: But I am poor and needy; Yet the Lord thinketh upon me: Thou art my help and my deliverer; Make no tarrying, O my God.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
units.rightText: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.

units.leftText: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to give him over to the will of his foes.
units.rightText: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive, And he shall be blessed upon the earth; And deliver not thou him unto the will of his enemies.

units.leftText: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
units.rightText: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing: Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.

units.leftText: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
units.rightText: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me: Heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

units.leftText: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
units.rightText: Mine enemies speak evil against me, saying, When will he die, and his name perish?

units.leftText: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
units.rightText: And if he come to see me, he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself: When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

units.leftText: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:
units.rightText: All that hate me whisper together against me; Against me do they devise my hurt.

units.leftText: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
units.rightText: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him; And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

units.leftText: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
units.rightText: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.
leftNotes: 41:9 Cited in John 13:18|JHN 13:18*

units.leftText: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
units.rightText: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, That I may requite them.

units.leftText: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
units.rightText: By this I know that thou delightest in me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

units.leftText: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
units.rightText: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen. BOOK II

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
units.rightText: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, So panteth my soul after thee, O God.
leftNotes: 42:1 In many Hebrew manuscripts Psalms 42 and 43 constitute one psalm. Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.

units.leftText: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
units.rightText: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: When shall I come and appear before God?
leftNotes: 42:2 Or and see the face of God?

units.leftText: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
units.rightText: My tears have been my food day and night, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

units.leftText: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the festive procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.
units.rightText: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, How I went with the throng, and led them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping holyday.

units.leftText: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
units.rightText: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him For the help of his countenance.

units.leftText: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon — even from Mount Mizar.
units.rightText: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: Therefore do I remember thee from the land of the Jordan, And the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.

units.leftText: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
units.rightText: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterfalls: All thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

units.leftText: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
units.rightText: Yet Jehovah will command his lovingkindness in the day-time; And in the night his song shall be with me, Even a prayer unto the God of my life.

units.leftText: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
units.rightText: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

units.leftText: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
units.rightText: As with a sword in my bones, mine adversaries reproach me, While they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

units.leftText: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
units.rightText: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, Who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

units.leftText: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
units.rightText: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

units.leftText: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
units.rightText: For thou art the God of my strength; why hast thou cast me off? Why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

units.leftText: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
units.rightText: Oh send out thy light and thy truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me unto thy holy hill, And to thy tabernacles.

units.leftText: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
units.rightText: Then will I go unto the altar of God, Unto God my exceeding joy; And upon the harp will I praise thee, O God, my God.

units.leftText: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
units.rightText: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why art thou disquieted within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise him, Who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
units.rightText: We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.
leftNotes: 44:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.

units.leftText: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
units.rightText: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand; But them thou didst plant: Thou didst afflict the peoples; But them thou didst spread abroad.

units.leftText: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
units.rightText: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them; But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable unto them.

units.leftText: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
units.rightText: Thou art my King, O God: Command deliverance for Jacob.

units.leftText: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
units.rightText: Through thee will we push down our adversaries: Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

units.leftText: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
units.rightText: For I will not trust in my bow, Neither shall my sword save me.
leftNotes: 44:6 Or give me victory; similarly in verse 7

units.leftText: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
units.rightText: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries, And hast put them to shame that hate us.

units.leftText: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
units.rightText: In God have we made our boast all the day long, And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. [Selah*

units.leftText: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
units.rightText: But now thou hast cast us off, and brought us to dishonor, And goest not forth with our hosts.

units.leftText: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
units.rightText: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; And they that hate us take spoil for themselves.

units.leftText: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
units.rightText: Thou hast made us like sheep appointed for food, And hast scattered us among the nations.

units.leftText: You sell Your people for nothing; no profit do You gain from their sale.
units.rightText: Thou sellest thy people for nought, And hast not increased thy wealth by their price.

units.leftText: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
units.rightText: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and a derision to them that are round about us.

units.leftText: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
units.rightText: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.
leftNotes: 44:14 Literally a shaking of the head

units.leftText: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
units.rightText: All the day long is my dishonor before me, And the shame of my face hath covered me,

units.leftText: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
units.rightText: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth, By reason of the enemy and the avenger.

units.leftText: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.
units.rightText: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

units.leftText: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
units.rightText: Our heart is not turned back, Neither have our steps declined from thy way,

units.leftText: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
units.rightText: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.
leftNotes: 44:19 Or serpents or dragons

units.leftText: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,
units.rightText: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or spread forth our hands to a strange god;

units.leftText: would not God have discovered, since He knows the secrets of the heart?
units.rightText: Will not God search this out? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

units.leftText: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
units.rightText: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
leftNotes: 44:22 Cited in Romans 8:36|ROM 8:36*

units.leftText: Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
units.rightText: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Arise, cast us not off for ever.

units.leftText: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
units.rightText: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

units.leftText: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
units.rightText: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our body cleaveth unto the earth.

units.leftText: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
units.rightText: Rise up for our help, And redeem us for thy lovingkindness’ sake.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
units.rightText: My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I speak the things which I have made touching the king: My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
leftNotes: 45:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.
45:1 Or King; here and throughout Psalm 45

units.leftText: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.
units.rightText: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured into thy lips: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

units.leftText: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
units.rightText: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, Thy glory and thy majesty.

units.leftText: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
units.rightText: And in thy majesty ride on prosperously, Because of truth and meekness and righteousness: And thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

units.leftText: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
units.rightText: Thine arrows are sharp; The peoples fall under thee; They are in the heart of the king’s enemies.

units.leftText: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
units.rightText: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.

units.leftText: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.
units.rightText: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness: Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
leftNotes: 45:7 Cited in Hebrews 1:8–9|HEB 1:8-9*

units.leftText: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
units.rightText: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.

units.leftText: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.
units.rightText: Kings’ daughters are among thy honorable women: At thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

units.leftText: Listen, O daughter! Consider and incline your ear: Forget your people and your father’s house,
units.rightText: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house:

units.leftText: and the king will desire your beauty; bow to him, for he is your lord.
units.rightText: So will the king desire thy beauty; For he is thy lord; and reverence thou him.

units.leftText: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.
units.rightText: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; The rich among the people shall entreat thy favor.

units.leftText: All glorious is the princess in her chamber; her gown is embroidered with gold.
units.rightText: The king’s daughter within the palace is all glorious: Her clothing is inwrought with gold.

units.leftText: In colorful garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions are brought before you.
units.rightText: She shall be led unto the king in broidered work: The virgins her companions that follow her Shall be brought unto thee.

units.leftText: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.
units.rightText: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be led: They shall enter into the king’s palace.

units.leftText: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.
units.rightText: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the earth.

units.leftText: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
units.rightText: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: Therefore shall the peoples give thee thanks for ever and ever.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
units.rightText: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
leftNotes: 46:1 Alamothis probably a musical or liturgical term; here and in 1 Chronicles 15:20|1CH 15:20*.

units.leftText: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
units.rightText: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be shaken into the heart of the seas;

units.leftText: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
units.rightText: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, Though the mountains tremble with the swelling thereof. [Selah*

units.leftText: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
