units.rightText: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.

units.leftText: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
units.rightText: I will sing of the lovingkindness of Jehovah for ever: With my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
leftNotes: 89:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.

units.leftText: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
units.rightText: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever; Thy faithfulness wilt thou establish in the very heavens.

units.leftText: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
units.rightText: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant:

units.leftText: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
units.rightText: Thy seed will I establish for ever, And build up thy throne to all generations. [Selah*

units.leftText: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD — Your faithfulness as well — in the assembly of the holy ones.
units.rightText: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Jehovah; Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

units.leftText: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
units.rightText: For who in the skies can be compared unto Jehovah? Who among the sons of the mighty is like unto Jehovah,
leftNotes: 89:6 Or the sons of God or the sons of might

units.leftText: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
units.rightText: A God very terrible in the council of the holy ones, And to be feared above all them that are round about him?

units.leftText: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
units.rightText: O Jehovah God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto thee, O Jehovah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.

units.leftText: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
units.rightText: Thou rulest the pride of the sea: When the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

units.leftText: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
units.rightText: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; Thou hast scattered thine enemies with the arm of thy strength.

units.leftText: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
units.rightText: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: The world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

units.leftText: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
units.rightText: The north and the south, thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon rejoice in thy name.

units.leftText: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
units.rightText: Thou hast a mighty arm; Strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

units.leftText: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
units.rightText: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of thy throne: Lovingkindness and truth go before thy face.

units.leftText: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
units.rightText: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: They walk, O Jehovah, in the light of thy countenance.

units.leftText: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
units.rightText: In thy name do they rejoice all the day; And in thy righteousness are they exalted.

units.leftText: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
units.rightText: For thou art the glory of their strength; And in thy favor our horn shall be exalted.

units.leftText: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
units.rightText: For our shield belongeth unto Jehovah; And our king to the Holy One of Israel.

units.leftText: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
units.rightText: Then thou spakest in vision to thy saints, And saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

units.leftText: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
units.rightText: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil have I anointed him:

units.leftText: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
units.rightText: With whom my hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.

units.leftText: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
units.rightText: The enemy shall not exact from him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

units.leftText: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
units.rightText: And I will beat down his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.

units.leftText: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
units.rightText: But my faithfulness and my lovingkindness shall be with him; And in my name shall his horn be exalted.

units.leftText: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
units.rightText: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.

units.leftText: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
units.rightText: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.

units.leftText: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
units.rightText: I also will make him my first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.

units.leftText: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
units.rightText: My lovingkindness will I keep for him for evermore; And my covenant shall stand fast with him.

units.leftText: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
units.rightText: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.

units.leftText: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
units.rightText: If his children forsake my law, And walk not in mine ordinances;

units.leftText: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
units.rightText: If they break my statutes, And keep not my commandments;

units.leftText: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
units.rightText: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.

units.leftText: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
units.rightText: But my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, Nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

units.leftText: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
units.rightText: My covenant will I not break, Nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

units.leftText: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness — I will not lie to David —
units.rightText: Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David:

units.leftText: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,
units.rightText: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before me.

units.leftText: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
units.rightText: It shall be established for ever as the moon, And as the faithful witness in the sky. [Selah*

units.leftText: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
units.rightText: But thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

units.leftText: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
units.rightText: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of thy servant: Thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

units.leftText: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
units.rightText: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.

units.leftText: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
units.rightText: All that pass by the way rob him: He is become a reproach to his neighbors.

units.leftText: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
units.rightText: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

units.leftText: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
units.rightText: Yea, thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.

units.leftText: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
units.rightText: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.

units.leftText: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
units.rightText: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: Thou hast covered him with shame. [Selah*

units.leftText: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
units.rightText: How long, O Jehovah? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? How long shall thy wrath burn like fire?

units.leftText: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
units.rightText: Oh remember how short my time is: For what vanity hast thou created all the children of men!

units.leftText: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
units.rightText: What man is he that shall live and not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? [Selah*

units.leftText: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
units.rightText: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, Which thou swarest unto David in thy faithfulness?

units.leftText: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people —
units.rightText: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty peoples,

units.leftText: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
units.rightText: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, Wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah for evermore. Amen, and Amen. BOOK IV

units.leftText: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
units.rightText: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.

units.leftText: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
units.rightText: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

units.leftText: You return man to dust, saying, “Return, O sons of mortals.”
units.rightText: Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.

units.leftText: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.
units.rightText: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.
leftNotes: 90:4 See 2 Peter 3:8|2PE 3:8*.

units.leftText: You sweep them away in their sleep; they are like the new grass of the morning—
units.rightText: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

units.leftText: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.
units.rightText: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

units.leftText: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
units.rightText: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.

units.leftText: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
units.rightText: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

units.leftText: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
units.rightText: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

units.leftText: The length of our days is seventy years — or eighty if we are strong — yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
units.rightText: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.

units.leftText: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
units.rightText: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?

units.leftText: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
units.rightText: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.

units.leftText: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
units.rightText: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

units.leftText: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
units.rightText: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

units.leftText: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
units.rightText: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.

units.leftText: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
units.rightText: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.

units.leftText: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!
units.rightText: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
leftNotes: 90:17 Or beauty

units.leftText: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
units.rightText: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
leftNotes: 91:1 Hebrew Shaddai

units.leftText: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
units.rightText: I will say of Jehovah, He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in whom I trust.

units.leftText: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
units.rightText: For he will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the deadly pestilence.

units.leftText: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
units.rightText: He will cover thee with his pinions, And under his wings shalt thou take refuge: His truth is a shield and a buckler.

units.leftText: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
units.rightText: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, Nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

units.leftText: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
units.rightText: For the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

units.leftText: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
units.rightText: A thousand shall fall at thy side, And ten thousand at thy right hand; But it shall not come nigh thee.

units.leftText: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
units.rightText: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the reward of the wicked.

units.leftText: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
units.rightText: For thou, O Jehovah, art my refuge! Thou hast made the Most High thy habitation;

units.leftText: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
units.rightText: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.

units.leftText: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
units.rightText: For he will give his angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.

units.leftText: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
units.rightText: They shall bear thee up in their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
leftNotes: 91:12 Cited in Matthew 4:6|MAT 4:6* and Luke 4:10–11

units.leftText: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
units.rightText: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under foot.

units.leftText: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
units.rightText: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

units.leftText: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
units.rightText: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble: I will deliver him, and honor him.

units.leftText: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
units.rightText: With long life will I satisfy him, And show him my salvation.

units.leftText: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
units.rightText: It is a good thing to give thanks unto Jehovah, And to sing praises unto thy name, O Most High;

units.leftText: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
units.rightText: To show forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, And thy faithfulness every night,

units.leftText: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
units.rightText: With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.

units.leftText: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
units.rightText: For thou, Jehovah, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

units.leftText: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
units.rightText: How great are thy works, O Jehovah! Thy thoughts are very deep.

units.leftText: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,
units.rightText: A brutish man knoweth not; Neither doth a fool understand this:

units.leftText: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
units.rightText: When the wicked spring as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they shall be destroyed for ever.

units.leftText: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
units.rightText: But thou, O Jehovah, art on high for evermore.

units.leftText: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
units.rightText: For, lo, thine enemies, O Jehovah, For, lo, thine enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

units.leftText: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
units.rightText: But my horn hast thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.

units.leftText: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
units.rightText: Mine eye also hath seen my desire on mine enemies, Mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.
leftNotes: 92:11 Or my ears hear evildoers when they rise against me

units.leftText: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
units.rightText: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree: He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

units.leftText: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
units.rightText: They are planted in the house of Jehovah; They shall flourish in the courts of our God.

units.leftText: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
units.rightText: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and green:

units.leftText: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
units.rightText: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

units.leftText: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
units.rightText: Jehovah reigneth; he is clothed with majesty; Jehovah is clothed with strength; he hath girded himself therewith: The world also is established, that it cannot be moved.

units.leftText: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
units.rightText: Thy throne is established of old: Thou art from everlasting.

units.leftText: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
units.rightText: The floods have lifted up, O Jehovah, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.

units.leftText: Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.
units.rightText: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, Jehovah on high is mighty.

units.leftText: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
units.rightText: Thy testimonies are very sure: Holiness becometh thy house, O Jehovah, for evermore.

units.leftText: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

units.leftText: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
units.rightText: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud their desert.

units.leftText: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
units.rightText: Jehovah, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked triumph?

units.leftText: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
units.rightText: They prate, they speak arrogantly: All the workers of iniquity boast themselves.

units.leftText: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.
units.rightText: They break in pieces thy people, O Jehovah, And afflict thy heritage.

units.leftText: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
units.rightText: They slay the widow and the sojourner, And murder the fatherless.

units.leftText: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
units.rightText: And they say, Jehovah will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob consider.

units.leftText: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?
units.rightText: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?

units.leftText: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?
units.rightText: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? He that formed the eye, shall he not see?

units.leftText: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?
units.rightText: He that chastiseth the nations, shall not he correct, Even he that teacheth man knowledge?

units.leftText: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
units.rightText: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
leftNotes: 94:11 Cited in 1 Corinthians 3:20|1CO 3:20*

units.leftText: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
units.rightText: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Jehovah, And teachest out of thy law;

units.leftText: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
units.rightText: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

units.leftText: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.
units.rightText: For Jehovah will not cast off his people, Neither will he forsake his inheritance.

units.leftText: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
units.rightText: For judgment shall return unto righteousness; And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

units.leftText: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?
units.rightText: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

units.leftText: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
units.rightText: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

units.leftText: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
units.rightText: When I said, My foot slippeth; Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, held me up.

units.leftText: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
units.rightText: In the multitude of my thoughts within me Thy comforts delight my soul.

units.leftText: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally — one devising mischief by decree?
units.rightText: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?

units.leftText: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
units.rightText: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn the innocent blood.
leftNotes: 94:21 Or condemn innocent blood

units.leftText: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
units.rightText: But Jehovah hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.

units.leftText: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
units.rightText: And he hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own wickedness; Jehovah our God will cut them off.

units.leftText: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
units.rightText: Oh come, let us sing unto Jehovah; Let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

units.leftText: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
units.rightText: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; Let us make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

units.leftText: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
units.rightText: For Jehovah is a great God, And a great King above all gods.

units.leftText: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
units.rightText: In his hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the mountains are his also.

units.leftText: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
units.rightText: The sea is his, and he made it; And his hands formed the dry land.

units.leftText: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
units.rightText: Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker:

units.leftText: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,
units.rightText: For he is our God, And we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To-day, oh that ye would hear his voice!

units.leftText: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness,
units.rightText: Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;
leftNotes: 95:8 LXX as you did in the rebellion; Meribah means quarreling; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7*; cited in Hebrews 3:15 and Hebrews 4:7.
95:8 LXX in the day of testing in the wilderness; Massah means testing; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7*.

units.leftText: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
units.rightText: When your fathers tempted me, Proved me, and saw my work.

units.leftText: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”
units.rightText: Forty years long was I grieved with that generation, And said, It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known my ways:
leftNotes: 95:10 LXX They always go astray in the heart

units.leftText: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
units.rightText: Wherefore I sware in my wrath, That they should not enter into my rest.
leftNotes: 95:11 Cited in Hebrews 3:7–11|HEB 3:7-11*, Hebrews 4:3, and Hebrews 4:5

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
units.rightText: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song: Sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.
units.rightText: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; Show forth his salvation from day to day.

units.leftText: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
units.rightText: Declare his glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

units.leftText: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
units.rightText: For great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised: He is to be feared above all gods.

units.leftText: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
units.rightText: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; But Jehovah made the heavens.

units.leftText: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
units.rightText: Honor and majesty are before him: Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

units.leftText: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
units.rightText: Ascribe unto Jehovah, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

units.leftText: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
units.rightText: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name: Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

units.leftText: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
units.rightText: Oh worship Jehovah in holy array: Tremble before him, all the earth.

units.leftText: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
units.rightText: Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth: The world also is established that it cannot be moved: He will judge the peoples with equity.

units.leftText: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
units.rightText: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

units.leftText: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest
units.rightText: Let the field exult, and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy

units.leftText: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
units.rightText: Before Jehovah; for he cometh, For he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with his truth.

units.leftText: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
units.rightText: Jehovah reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.

units.leftText: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
units.rightText: Clouds and darkness are round about him: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

units.leftText: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
units.rightText: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.

units.leftText: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
units.rightText: His lightnings lightened the world: The earth saw, and trembled.

units.leftText: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
units.rightText: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of Jehovah, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

units.leftText: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
units.rightText: The heavens declare his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.

units.leftText: All worshipers of images are put to shame — those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
units.rightText: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.

units.leftText: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
units.rightText: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced, Because of thy judgments, O Jehovah.

units.leftText: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
units.rightText: For thou, Jehovah, art most high above all the earth: Thou art exalted far above all gods.

units.leftText: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
units.rightText: O ye that love Jehovah, hate evil: He preserveth the souls of his saints; He delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

units.leftText: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
units.rightText: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
leftNotes: 97:11 One Hebrew manuscript, LXX, Syriac, and Vulgate; most Hebrew manuscripts Light is sown

units.leftText: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
units.rightText: Be glad in Jehovah, ye righteous; And give thanks to his holy memorial name.

units.leftText: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
units.rightText: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.

units.leftText: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.

units.leftText: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
units.rightText: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

units.leftText: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth — let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
units.rightText: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

units.leftText: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
units.rightText: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.

units.leftText: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
units.rightText: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.

units.leftText: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
units.rightText: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;

units.leftText: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy
units.rightText: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together

units.leftText: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
units.rightText: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.

units.leftText: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
units.rightText: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He sitteth above the cherubim; let the earth be moved.

units.leftText: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
units.rightText: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.

units.leftText: Let them praise Your great and awesome name — He is holy!
units.rightText: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.
leftNotes: 99:3 Or it is holy!

units.leftText: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
units.rightText: The king’s strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.
leftNotes: 99:4 Or The might of the King loves justice.

units.leftText: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
units.rightText: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.

units.leftText: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.
units.rightText: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.

units.leftText: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
units.rightText: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.

units.leftText: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
units.rightText: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.

units.leftText: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
units.rightText: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.

units.leftText: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
units.rightText: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all ye lands.

units.leftText: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
units.rightText: Serve Jehovah with gladness: Come before his presence with singing.

units.leftText: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
units.rightText: Know ye that Jehovah, he is God: It is he that hath made us, and we are his; We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
leftNotes: 100:3 Or and not we ourselves

units.leftText: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
units.rightText: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, And into his courts with praise: Give thanks unto him, and bless his name.

units.leftText: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
units.rightText: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
units.rightText: I will sing of lovingkindness and justice: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I sing praises.

units.leftText: I will ponder the way that is blameless — when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
units.rightText: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way: Oh when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

units.leftText: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
units.rightText: I will set no base thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; It shall not cleave unto me.

units.leftText: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
units.rightText: A perverse heart shall depart from me: I will know no evil thing.

units.leftText: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
units.rightText: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I destroy: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.

units.leftText: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
units.rightText: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: He that walketh in a perfect way, he shall minister unto me.

units.leftText: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
units.rightText: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: He that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.

units.leftText: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
units.rightText: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; To cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of Jehovah.

units.leftText: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
units.rightText: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.

units.leftText: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
units.rightText: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.

units.leftText: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
units.rightText: For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.

units.leftText: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
units.rightText: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.

units.leftText: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.
units.rightText: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.

units.leftText: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
units.rightText: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.

units.leftText: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
units.rightText: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.

units.leftText: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
units.rightText: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.

units.leftText: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
units.rightText: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,

units.leftText: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
units.rightText: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

units.leftText: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
units.rightText: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.

units.leftText: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
units.rightText: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial name unto all generations.

units.leftText: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor — the appointed time has come.
units.rightText: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.

units.leftText: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
units.rightText: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.

units.leftText: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
units.rightText: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.

units.leftText: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
units.rightText: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.

units.leftText: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
units.rightText: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.

units.leftText: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
units.rightText: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.

units.leftText: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
units.rightText: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;

units.leftText: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,
units.rightText: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;

units.leftText: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,
units.rightText: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;

units.leftText: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.
units.rightText: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.

units.leftText: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.
units.rightText: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

units.leftText: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
units.rightText: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.

units.leftText: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
units.rightText: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.

units.leftText: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
units.rightText: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

units.leftText: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
units.rightText: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.
leftNotes: 102:27 Cited in Hebrews 1:10–12|HEB 1:10-12*

units.leftText: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
units.rightText: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.

units.leftText: Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
units.rightText: Bless Jehovah, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless his holy name.

units.leftText: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds —
units.rightText: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, And forget not all his benefits:

units.leftText: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
units.rightText: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; Who healeth all thy diseases;

units.leftText: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
units.rightText: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; Who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

units.leftText: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
units.rightText: Who satisfieth thy desire with good things, So that thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

units.leftText: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
units.rightText: Jehovah executeth righteous acts, And judgments for all that are oppressed.

units.leftText: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
units.rightText: He made known his ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.

units.leftText: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
units.rightText: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abundant in lovingkindness.

units.leftText: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
units.rightText: He will not always chide; Neither will he keep his anger for ever.

units.leftText: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
units.rightText: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor rewarded us after our iniquities.

units.leftText: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
units.rightText: For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is his lovingkindness toward them that fear him.

units.leftText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
units.rightText: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

units.leftText: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
units.rightText: Like as a father pitieth his children, So Jehovah pitieth them that fear him.

units.leftText: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
units.rightText: For he knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.

units.leftText: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;
units.rightText: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

units.leftText: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
units.rightText: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof shall know it no more.

units.leftText: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children —
units.rightText: But the lovingkindness of Jehovah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, And his righteousness unto children’s children;

units.leftText: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
units.rightText: To such as keep his covenant, And to those that remember his precepts to do them.

units.leftText: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath established his throne in the heavens; And his kingdom ruleth over all.

units.leftText: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
units.rightText: Bless Jehovah, ye his angels, That are mighty in strength, that fulfil his word, Hearkening unto the voice of his word.

units.leftText: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.
units.rightText: Bless Jehovah, all ye his hosts, Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

units.leftText: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
units.rightText: Bless Jehovah, all ye his works, In all places of his dominion: Bless Jehovah, O my soul.

units.leftText: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
units.rightText: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:

units.leftText: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
units.rightText: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment; Who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;

units.leftText: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
units.rightText: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters; Who maketh the clouds his chariot; Who walketh upon the wings of the wind;

units.leftText: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
units.rightText: Who maketh winds his messengers; Flames of fire his ministers;
leftNotes: 104:4 LXX He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire.Cited in Hebrews 1:7|HEB 1:7*

units.leftText: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
units.rightText: Who laid the foundations of the earth, That it should not be moved for ever.

units.leftText: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
units.rightText: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a vesture; The waters stood above the mountains.

units.leftText: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away —
units.rightText: At thy rebuke they fled; At the voice of thy thunder they hasted away

units.leftText: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them —
units.rightText: (The mountains rose, the valleys sank down) Unto the place which thou hadst founded for them.

units.leftText: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
units.rightText: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; That they turn not again to cover the earth.

units.leftText: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
units.rightText: He sendeth forth springs into the valleys; They run among the mountains;

units.leftText: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
units.rightText: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild asses quench their thirst.

units.leftText: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
units.rightText: By them the birds of the heavens have their habitation; They sing among the branches.

units.leftText: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
units.rightText: He watereth the mountains from his chambers: The earth is filled with the fruit of thy works.

units.leftText: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
units.rightText: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; That he may bring forth food out of the earth,

units.leftText: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
units.rightText: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, And oil to make his face to shine, And bread that strengtheneth man’s heart.

units.leftText: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
units.rightText: The trees of Jehovah are filled with moisture, The cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

units.leftText: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
units.rightText: Where the birds make their nests: As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.
leftNotes: 104:17 Or pines or junipers or firs

units.leftText: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
units.rightText: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.
leftNotes: 104:18 Or the coneys or the hyraxes

units.leftText: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
units.rightText: He appointed the moon for seasons: The sun knoweth his going down.

units.leftText: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
units.rightText: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest creep forth.

units.leftText: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
units.rightText: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.

units.leftText: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
units.rightText: The sun ariseth, they get them away, And lay them down in their dens.

units.leftText: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
units.rightText: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labor until the evening.

units.leftText: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, how manifold are thy works! In wisdom hast thou made them all: The earth is full of thy riches.

units.leftText: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
units.rightText: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.

units.leftText: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
units.rightText: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom thou hast formed to play therein.

units.leftText: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
units.rightText: These wait all for thee, That thou mayest give them their food in due season.

units.leftText: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
units.rightText: Thou givest unto them, they gather; Thou openest thy hand, they are satisfied with good.

units.leftText: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
units.rightText: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled; Thou takest away their breath, they die, And return to their dust.

units.leftText: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
units.rightText: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.
leftNotes: 104:30 Or breath

units.leftText: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
units.rightText: Let the glory of Jehovah endure for ever; Let Jehovah rejoice in his works:

units.leftText: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
units.rightText: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

units.leftText: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
units.rightText: I will sing unto Jehovah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

units.leftText: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
units.rightText: Let my meditation be sweet unto him: I will rejoice in Jehovah.

units.leftText: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. And let the wicked be no more. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 104:35 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name; Make known among the peoples his doings.

units.leftText: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
units.rightText: Sing unto him, sing praises unto him; Talk ye of all his marvellous works.

units.leftText: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
units.rightText: Glory ye in his holy name: Let the heart of them rejoice that seek Jehovah.

units.leftText: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
units.rightText: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.

units.leftText: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
units.rightText: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

units.leftText: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
units.rightText: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, Ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

units.leftText: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
units.rightText: He is Jehovah our God: His judgments are in all the earth.

units.leftText: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
units.rightText: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, The word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

units.leftText: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
units.rightText: The covenant which he made with Abraham, And his oath unto Isaac,

units.leftText: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
units.rightText: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant,

units.leftText: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
units.rightText: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance;

units.leftText: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
units.rightText: When they were but a few men in number, Yea, very few, and sojourners in it.

units.leftText: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
units.rightText: And they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.

units.leftText: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
units.rightText: He suffered no man to do them wrong; Yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

units.leftText: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
units.rightText: Saying, Touch not mine anointed ones, And do my prophets no harm.

units.leftText: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
units.rightText: And he called for a famine upon the land; He brake the whole staff of bread.
leftNotes: 105:16 Hebrew staff

units.leftText: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
units.rightText: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant:

units.leftText: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
units.rightText: His feet they hurt with fetters: He was laid in chains of iron,

units.leftText: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
units.rightText: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of Jehovah tried him.

units.leftText: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
units.rightText: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

units.leftText: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
units.rightText: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his substance;

units.leftText: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
units.rightText: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
leftNotes: 105:22 LXX and Syriac; MT to bind

units.leftText: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
units.rightText: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

units.leftText: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
units.rightText: And he increased his people greatly, And made them stronger than their adversaries.

units.leftText: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
units.rightText: He turned their heart to hate his people, To deal subtly with his servants.

units.leftText: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
units.rightText: He sent Moses his servant, And Aaron whom he had chosen.

units.leftText: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
units.rightText: They set among them his signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.

units.leftText: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.
units.rightText: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they rebelled not against his words.
leftNotes: 105:28 LXX and Syriac; Hebrew for had they not defied His words?

units.leftText: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
units.rightText: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.

units.leftText: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
units.rightText: Their land swarmed with frogs In the chambers of their kings.

units.leftText: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.
units.rightText: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.

units.leftText: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
units.rightText: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.

units.leftText: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
units.rightText: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.

units.leftText: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.
units.rightText: He spake, and the locust came, And the grasshopper, and that without number,

units.leftText: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
units.rightText: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.

units.leftText: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
units.rightText: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The chief of all their strength.

units.leftText: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
units.rightText: And he brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was not one feeble person among his tribes.

units.leftText: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
units.rightText: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.

units.leftText: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
units.rightText: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.

units.leftText: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
units.rightText: They asked, and he brought quails, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

units.leftText: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
units.rightText: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran in the dry places like a river.

units.leftText: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
units.rightText: For he remembered his holy word, And Abraham his servant.

units.leftText: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
units.rightText: And he brought forth his people with joy, And his chosen with singing.

units.leftText: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
units.rightText: And he gave them the lands of the nations; And they took the labor of the peoples in possession:

units.leftText: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: That they might keep his statutes, And observe his laws. Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 105:45 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
leftNotes: 106:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 48

units.leftText: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
units.rightText: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?

units.leftText: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
units.rightText: Blessed are they that keep justice, And he that doeth righteousness at all times.

units.leftText: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
units.rightText: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the favor that thou bearest unto thy people; Oh visit me with thy salvation,

units.leftText: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
units.rightText: That I may see the prosperity of thy chosen, That I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, That I may glory with thine inheritance.

units.leftText: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
units.rightText: We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

units.leftText: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
units.rightText: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; They remembered not the multitude of thy lovingkindnesses, But were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
leftNotes: 106:7 Or the Sea of Reeds; also in verses 9 and 22

units.leftText: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
units.rightText: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, That he might make his mighty power to be known.

units.leftText: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
units.rightText: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up: So he led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.

units.leftText: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
units.rightText: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

units.leftText: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
units.rightText: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.

units.leftText: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
units.rightText: Then believed they his words; They sang his praise.

units.leftText: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
units.rightText: They soon forgat his works; They waited not for his counsel,

units.leftText: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
units.rightText: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tempted God in the desert.

units.leftText: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
units.rightText: And he gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.

units.leftText: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
units.rightText: They envied Moses also in the camp, And Aaron the saint of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
units.rightText: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.

units.leftText: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
units.rightText: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.

units.leftText: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
units.rightText: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.
leftNotes: 106:19 That is, Mount Sinai, or possibly a mountain in the range containing Mount Sinai

units.leftText: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
units.rightText: Thus they changed their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.
leftNotes: 106:20 Or their glorious God

units.leftText: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
units.rightText: They forgat God their Saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt,

units.leftText: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
units.rightText: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, And terrible things by the Red Sea.

units.leftText: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
units.rightText: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, Had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

units.leftText: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
units.rightText: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, They believed not his word,

units.leftText: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
units.rightText: But murmured in their tents, And hearkened not unto the voice of Jehovah.

units.leftText: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
units.rightText: Therefore he sware unto them, That he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

units.leftText: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
units.rightText: And that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.
leftNotes: 106:27 Or cast down or cause to fall

units.leftText: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
units.rightText: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.

units.leftText: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
units.rightText: Thus they provoked him to anger with their doings; And the plague brake in upon them.

units.leftText: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
units.rightText: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment; And so the plague was stayed.

units.leftText: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
units.rightText: And that was reckoned unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for evermore.

units.leftText: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
units.rightText: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, So that it went ill with Moses for their sakes;
leftNotes: 106:32 Meribah means quarreling; see Exodus 17:7|EXO 17:7*.

units.leftText: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
units.rightText: Because they were rebellious against his spirit, And he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
leftNotes: 106:33 Or they provoked His Spirit

units.leftText: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
units.rightText: They did not destroy the peoples, As Jehovah commanded them,

units.leftText: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
units.rightText: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works,

units.leftText: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
units.rightText: And served their idols, Which became a snare unto them.

units.leftText: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
units.rightText: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

units.leftText: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
units.rightText: And shed innocent blood, Even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.

units.leftText: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
units.rightText: Thus were they defiled with their works, And played the harlot in their doings.

units.leftText: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
units.rightText: Therefore was the wrath of Jehovah kindled against his people, And he abhorred his inheritance.

units.leftText: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
units.rightText: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.

units.leftText: Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.
units.rightText: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.

units.leftText: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
units.rightText: Many times did he deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And were brought low in their iniquity.

units.leftText: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
units.rightText: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, When he heard their cry:

units.leftText: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
units.rightText: And he remembered for them his covenant, And repented according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

units.leftText: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
units.rightText: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.

units.leftText: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
units.rightText: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And gather us from among the nations, To give thanks unto thy holy name, And to triumph in thy praise.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting even to everlasting. And let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye Jehovah. BOOK V

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: O give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
units.rightText: Let the redeemed of Jehovah say so, Whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

units.leftText: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
units.rightText: And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.
leftNotes: 107:3 Hebrew north and the sea

units.leftText: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
units.rightText: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.

units.leftText: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
units.rightText: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.

units.leftText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
units.rightText: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he delivered them out of their distresses,

units.leftText: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
