units.rightText: He led them also by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.

units.leftText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
units.rightText: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

units.leftText: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
units.rightText: For he satisfieth the longing soul, And the hungry soul he filleth with good.

units.leftText: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
units.rightText: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron,

units.leftText: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
units.rightText: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High:

units.leftText: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
units.rightText: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.

units.leftText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
units.rightText: Then they cried unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saved them out of their distresses.

units.leftText: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
units.rightText: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And brake their bonds in sunder.

units.leftText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
units.rightText: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

units.leftText: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
units.rightText: For he hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.

units.leftText: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
units.rightText: Fools because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

units.leftText: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
units.rightText: Their soul abhorreth all manner of food; And they draw near unto the gates of death.

units.leftText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
units.rightText: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he saveth them out of their distresses.

units.leftText: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
units.rightText: He sendeth his word, and healeth them, And delivereth them from their destructions.

units.leftText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
units.rightText: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

units.leftText: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
units.rightText: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare his works with singing.

units.leftText: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
units.rightText: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters;

units.leftText: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
units.rightText: These see the works of Jehovah, And his wonders in the deep.

units.leftText: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
units.rightText: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, Which lifteth up the waves thereof.

units.leftText: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
units.rightText: They mount up to the heavens, they go down again to the depths: Their soul melteth away because of trouble.

units.leftText: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
units.rightText: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits’ end.
leftNotes: 107:27 Or and all their wisdom was swallowed up or and they were at their wits’ end

units.leftText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
units.rightText: Then they cry unto Jehovah in their trouble, And he bringeth them out of their distresses.

units.leftText: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
units.rightText: He maketh the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof are still.
leftNotes: 107:29 DSS; MT their waves

units.leftText: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
units.rightText: Then are they glad because they are quiet; So he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

units.leftText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
units.rightText: Oh that men would praise Jehovah for his lovingkindness, And for his wonderful works to the children of men!

units.leftText: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
units.rightText: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, And praise him in the seat of the elders.

units.leftText: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
units.rightText: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;

units.leftText: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
units.rightText: A fruitful land into a salt desert, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

units.leftText: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
units.rightText: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.

units.leftText: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
units.rightText: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, That they may prepare a city of habitation,

units.leftText: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
units.rightText: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, And get them fruits of increase.

units.leftText: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
units.rightText: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; And he suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

units.leftText: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
units.rightText: Again, they are diminished and bowed down Through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

units.leftText: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
units.rightText: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.

units.leftText: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
units.rightText: Yet setteth he the needy on high from affliction, And maketh him families like a flock.

units.leftText: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
units.rightText: The upright shall see it, and be glad; And all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

units.leftText: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
units.rightText: Whoso is wise will give heed to these things; And they will consider the lovingkindnesses of Jehovah.

units.leftText: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
units.rightText: My heart is fixed, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
leftNotes: 108:1 Or with my glory

units.leftText: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
units.rightText: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake right early.

units.leftText: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
units.rightText: I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

units.leftText: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
units.rightText: For thy lovingkindness is great above the heavens; And thy truth reacheth unto the skies.

units.leftText: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
units.rightText: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.

units.leftText: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
units.rightText: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

units.leftText: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
units.rightText: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
leftNotes: 108:7 Or in His holiness

units.leftText: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
units.rightText: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

units.leftText: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
units.rightText: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe; Over Philistia will I shout.

units.leftText: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
units.rightText: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who hath led me unto Edom?

units.leftText: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
units.rightText: Hast not thou cast us off, O God? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

units.leftText: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
units.rightText: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

units.leftText: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
units.rightText: Through God we shall do valiantly: For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent.
units.rightText: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

units.leftText: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
units.rightText: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

units.leftText: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
units.rightText: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

units.leftText: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
units.rightText: For my love they are my adversaries: But I give myself unto prayer.

units.leftText: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
units.rightText: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

units.leftText: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
units.rightText: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.

units.leftText: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
units.rightText: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer be turned into sin.

units.leftText: May his days be few; may another take his position.
units.rightText: Let his days be few; And let another take his office.
leftNotes: 109:8 Cited in Acts 1:20|ACT 1:20*

units.leftText: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
units.rightText: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

units.leftText: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
units.rightText: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.
leftNotes: 109:10 Hebrew; LXX may they be driven

units.leftText: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
units.rightText: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.

units.leftText: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
units.rightText: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.

units.leftText: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
units.rightText: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

units.leftText: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
units.rightText: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

units.leftText: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
units.rightText: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

units.leftText: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.
units.rightText: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay them.

units.leftText: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
units.rightText: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

units.leftText: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
units.rightText: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.

units.leftText: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
units.rightText: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

units.leftText: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
units.rightText: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.

units.leftText: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
units.rightText: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name’s sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;

units.leftText: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
units.rightText: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

units.leftText: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
units.rightText: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

units.leftText: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
units.rightText: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.

units.leftText: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
units.rightText: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.

units.leftText: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
units.rightText: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:

units.leftText: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
units.rightText: That they may know that this is thy hand; That thou, Jehovah, hast done it.

units.leftText: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
units.rightText: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.

units.leftText: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
units.rightText: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

units.leftText: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
units.rightText: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

units.leftText: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
units.rightText: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
units.rightText: Jehovah saith unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, Until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
leftNotes: 110:1 Cited in Matthew 22:44|MAT 22:44*, Mark 12:36, Luke 20:42–43, Acts 2:34–35, and Hebrews 1:13

units.leftText: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
units.rightText: Jehovah will send forth the rod of thy strength out of Zion: Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

units.leftText: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
units.rightText: Thy people offer themselves willingly In the day of thy power, in holy array: Out of the womb of the morning Thou hast the dew of thy youth.

units.leftText: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
units.rightText: Jehovah hath sworn, and will not repent: Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
leftNotes: 110:4 Cited in Hebrews 5:6|HEB 5:6*, Hebrews 7:17, and Hebrews 7:21

units.leftText: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
units.rightText: The Lord at thy right hand Will strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

units.leftText: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
units.rightText: He will judge among the nations, He will fill the places with dead bodies; He will strike through the head in many countries.

units.leftText: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
units.rightText: He will drink of the brook in the way: Therefore will he lift up the head.

units.leftText: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. I will give thanks unto Jehovah with my whole heart, In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
leftNotes: 111:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD. This psalm is an acrostic poem, each line beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
units.rightText: The works of Jehovah are great, Sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

units.leftText: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
units.rightText: His work is honor and majesty; And his righteousness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
units.rightText: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: Jehovah is gracious and merciful.

units.leftText: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
units.rightText: He hath given food unto them that fear him: He will ever be mindful of his covenant.

units.leftText: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
units.rightText: He hath showed his people the power of his works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.

units.leftText: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
units.rightText: The works of his hands are truth and justice; All his precepts are sure.

units.leftText: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
units.rightText: They are established for ever and ever; They are done in truth and uprightness.

units.leftText: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
units.rightText: He hath sent redemption unto his people; He hath commanded his covenant for ever: Holy and reverend is his name.

units.leftText: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
units.rightText: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do his commandments: His praise endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.
leftNotes: 112:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD. This psalm is an acrostic poem, each line beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
units.rightText: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.

units.leftText: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
units.rightText: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright — for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
units.rightText: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: He is gracious, and merciful, and righteous.

units.leftText: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
units.rightText: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.

units.leftText: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
units.rightText: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

units.leftText: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
units.rightText: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.

units.leftText: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
units.rightText: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he see his desire upon his adversaries.

units.leftText: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
units.rightText: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.
leftNotes: 112:9 Cited in 2 Corinthians 9:9|2CO 9:9*

units.leftText: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
units.rightText: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.

units.leftText: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.
leftNotes: 113:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 9

units.leftText: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
units.rightText: Blessed be the name of Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.

units.leftText: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
units.rightText: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same Jehovah’s name is to be praised.

units.leftText: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.
units.rightText: Jehovah is high above all nations, And his glory above the heavens.

units.leftText: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
units.rightText: Who is like unto Jehovah our God, That hath his seat on high,

units.leftText: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
units.rightText: That humbleth himself to behold The things that are in heaven and in the earth?

units.leftText: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
units.rightText: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy from the dunghill;

units.leftText: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
units.rightText: That he may set him with princes, Even with the princes of his people.

units.leftText: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, And to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye Jehovah.

units.leftText: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
units.rightText: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

units.leftText: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel His dominion.
units.rightText: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

units.leftText: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
units.rightText: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.

units.leftText: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
units.rightText: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.

units.leftText: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
units.rightText: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?

units.leftText: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
units.rightText: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?

units.leftText: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
units.rightText: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,

units.leftText: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
units.rightText: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.

units.leftText: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
units.rightText: Not unto us, O Jehovah, not unto us, But unto thy name give glory, For thy lovingkindness, and for thy truth’s sake.

units.leftText: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
units.rightText: Wherefore should the nations say, Where is now their God?

units.leftText: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
units.rightText: But our God is in the heavens: He hath done whatsoever he pleased.

units.leftText: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
units.rightText: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.

units.leftText: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
units.rightText: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

units.leftText: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
units.rightText: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;

units.leftText: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
units.rightText: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they through their throat.
leftNotes: 115:7 Literally they cannot utter with their throat

units.leftText: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
units.rightText: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

units.leftText: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
units.rightText: O Israel, trust thou in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.
leftNotes: 115:9 MT; many Hebrew manuscripts, LXX, and Syriac O house of Israel

units.leftText: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
units.rightText: O house of Aaron, trust ye in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

units.leftText: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
units.rightText: Ye that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah: He is their help and their shield.

units.leftText: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
units.rightText: Jehovah hath been mindful of us; he will bless us: He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.

units.leftText: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
units.rightText: He will bless them that fear Jehovah, Both small and great.

units.leftText: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
units.rightText: Jehovah increase you more and more, You and your children.

units.leftText: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
units.rightText: Blessed are ye of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

units.leftText: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
units.rightText: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.

units.leftText: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
units.rightText: The dead praise not Jehovah, Neither any that go down into silence;

units.leftText: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: But we will bless Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore. Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 115:18 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice — my appeal for mercy.
units.rightText: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.

units.leftText: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
units.rightText: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

units.leftText: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
units.rightText: The cords of death compassed me, And the pains of Sheol gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

units.leftText: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
units.rightText: Then called I upon the name of Jehovah: O Jehovah, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
units.rightText: Gracious is Jehovah, and righteous; Yea, our God is merciful.

units.leftText: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
units.rightText: Jehovah preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he saved me.

units.leftText: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
units.rightText: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; For Jehovah hath dealt bountifully with thee.

units.leftText: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
units.rightText: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from falling.

units.leftText: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
units.rightText: I will walk before Jehovah In the land of the living.

units.leftText: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
units.rightText: I believe, for I will speak: I was greatly afflicted:
leftNotes: 116:10 LXX therefore I have spoken; cited in 2 Corinthians 4:13|2CO 4:13*

units.leftText: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
units.rightText: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

units.leftText: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
units.rightText: What shall I render unto Jehovah For all his benefits toward me?

units.leftText: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
units.rightText: I will take the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of Jehovah.

units.leftText: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
units.rightText: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people.

units.leftText: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
units.rightText: Precious in the sight of Jehovah Is the death of his saints.

units.leftText: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, truly I am thy servant: I am thy servant, the son of thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bonds.

units.leftText: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
units.rightText: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of Jehovah.

units.leftText: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
units.rightText: I will pay my vows unto Jehovah, Yea, in the presence of all his people,

units.leftText: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: In the courts of Jehovah’s house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 116:19 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
units.rightText: O praise Jehovah, all ye nations; Laud him, all ye peoples.
leftNotes: 117:1 Cited in Romans 15:11|ROM 15:11*

units.leftText: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: For his lovingkindness is great toward us; And the truth of Jehovah endureth for ever. Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 117:2 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
units.rightText: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
leftNotes: 118:2 LXX the house of Israel

units.leftText: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
units.rightText: Let the house of Aaron now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
units.rightText: Let them now that fear Jehovah say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
units.rightText: Out of my distress I called upon Jehovah: Jehovah answered me and set me in a large place.

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
units.rightText: Jehovah is on my side; I will not fear: What can man do unto me?
leftNotes: 118:6 Or The LORD is with me; also in verse 7; LXX The Lord is my helper
118:6 Cited in Hebrews 13:6|HEB 13:6*

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
units.rightText: Jehovah is on my side among them that help me: Therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in man.

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to put confidence in princes.

units.leftText: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
units.rightText: All nations compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

units.leftText: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
units.rightText: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

units.leftText: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
units.rightText: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: In the name of Jehovah I will cut them off.

units.leftText: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
units.rightText: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But Jehovah helped me.

units.leftText: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
units.rightText: Jehovah is my strength and song; And he is become my salvation.

units.leftText: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
units.rightText: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

units.leftText: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
units.rightText: The right hand of Jehovah is exalted: The right hand of Jehovah doeth valiantly.

units.leftText: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
units.rightText: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath chastened me sore; But he hath not given me over unto death.

units.leftText: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
units.rightText: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
units.rightText: This is the gate of Jehovah; The righteous shall enter into it.

units.leftText: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
units.rightText: I will give thanks unto thee; for thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.

units.leftText: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
units.rightText: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the head of the corner.
leftNotes: 118:22 Hebrew the head of the corner; cited in Matthew 21:42|MAT 21:42*, Mark 12:10, Luke 20:17, Acts 4:11, and 1 Peter 2:7

units.leftText: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
units.rightText: This is Jehovah’s doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.
leftNotes: 118:23 Cited in Matthew 21:42|MAT 21:42* and Mark 12:11

units.leftText: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
units.rightText: This is the day which Jehovah hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.

units.leftText: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
units.rightText: Save now, we beseech thee, O Jehovah: O Jehovah, we beseech thee, send now prosperity.
leftNotes: 118:25 Hebrew hosia-na, meaning save, we pray or save now; see Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9*, Matthew 21:15, Mark 11:9, and John 12:13.

units.leftText: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
units.rightText: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of Jehovah: We have blessed you out of the house of Jehovah.
leftNotes: 118:26 Cited in Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9*, Matthew 23:39, Mark 11:9, Luke 13:35, Luke 19:38, and John 12:13

units.leftText: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
units.rightText: Jehovah is God, and he hath given us light: Bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
leftNotes: 118:27 Or Join in the festal procession with boughs in hand, up to the horns of the altar.

units.leftText: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
units.rightText: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto thee: Thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
units.rightText: Blessed are they that are perfect in the way, Who walk in the law of Jehovah.
leftNotes: 119:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem of twenty-two stanzas, following the letters of the Hebrew alphabet; within a stanza, each verse begins with the same Hebrew letter.

units.leftText: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
units.rightText: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, That seek him with the whole heart.

units.leftText: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
units.rightText: Yea, they do no unrighteousness; They walk in his ways.

units.leftText: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
units.rightText: Thou hast commanded us thy precepts, That we should observe them diligently.

units.leftText: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
units.rightText: Oh that my ways were established To observe thy statutes!

units.leftText: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
units.rightText: Then shall I not be put to shame, When I have respect unto all thy commandments.

units.leftText: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
units.rightText: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.

units.leftText: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me. ב BETH
units.rightText: I will observe thy statutes: Oh forsake me not utterly. ב BETH.

units.leftText: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
units.rightText: Wherewith shall a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed thereto according to thy word.

units.leftText: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
units.rightText: With my whole heart have I sought thee: Oh let me not wander from thy commandments.

units.leftText: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
units.rightText: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, That I might not sin against thee.

units.leftText: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
units.rightText: Blessed art thou, O Jehovah: Teach me thy statutes.

units.leftText: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
units.rightText: With my lips have I declared All the ordinances of thy mouth.

units.leftText: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
units.rightText: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.

units.leftText: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
units.rightText: I will meditate on thy precepts, And have respect unto thy ways.

units.leftText: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word. ג GIMEL
units.rightText: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word. ג GIMEL.

units.leftText: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
units.rightText: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live; So will I observe thy word.

units.leftText: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
units.rightText: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold Wondrous things out of thy law.

units.leftText: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
units.rightText: I am a sojourner in the earth: Hide not thy commandments from me.

units.leftText: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
units.rightText: My soul breaketh for the longing That it hath unto thine ordinances at all times.

units.leftText: You rebuke the arrogant — the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
units.rightText: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, That do wander from thy commandments.

units.leftText: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
units.rightText: Take away from me reproach and contempt; For I have kept thy testimonies.

units.leftText: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
units.rightText: Princes also sat and talked against me; But thy servant did meditate on thy statutes.

units.leftText: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors. ד DALETH
units.rightText: Thy testimonies also are my delight And my counsellors. ד DALETH.

units.leftText: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
units.rightText: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: Quicken thou me according to thy word.

units.leftText: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
units.rightText: I declared my ways, and thou answeredst me: Teach me thy statutes.

units.leftText: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
units.rightText: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: So shall I meditate on thy wondrous works.

units.leftText: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
units.rightText: My soul melteth for heaviness: Strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

units.leftText: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
units.rightText: Remove from me the way of falsehood; And grant me thy law graciously.

units.leftText: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
units.rightText: I have chosen the way of faithfulness: Thine ordinances have I set before me.

units.leftText: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
units.rightText: I cleave unto thy testimonies: O Jehovah, put me not to shame.

units.leftText: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart. ה HE
units.rightText: I will run the way of thy commandments, When thou shalt enlarge my heart. ה HE.

units.leftText: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
units.rightText: Teach me, O Jehovah, the way of thy statutes; And I shall keep it unto the end.
leftNotes: 119:33 Or keep them as my reward

units.leftText: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
units.rightText: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; Yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

units.leftText: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
units.rightText: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; For therein do I delight.

units.leftText: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
units.rightText: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, And not to covetousness.

units.leftText: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
units.rightText: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, And quicken me in thy ways.
leftNotes: 119:37 Two MT manuscripts and DSS; most MT manuscripts in Your way

units.leftText: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
units.rightText: Confirm unto thy servant thy word, Which is in order unto the fear of thee.

units.leftText: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
units.rightText: Turn away my reproach whereof I am afraid; For thine ordinances are good.

units.leftText: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness. ו WAW
units.rightText: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: Quicken me in thy righteousness. ו VAV.

units.leftText: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
units.rightText: Let thy lovingkindnesses also come unto me, O Jehovah, Even thy salvation, according to thy word.

units.leftText: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
units.rightText: So shall I have an answer for him that reproacheth me; For I trust in thy word.

units.leftText: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
units.rightText: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; For I have hoped in thine ordinances.

units.leftText: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
units.rightText: So shall I observe thy law continually For ever and ever.

units.leftText: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
units.rightText: And I shall walk at liberty; For I have sought thy precepts.

units.leftText: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
units.rightText: I will also speak of thy testimonies before kings, And shall not be put to shame.

units.leftText: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
units.rightText: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, Which I have loved.

units.leftText: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes. ז ZAYIN
units.rightText: I will lift up my hands also unto thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate on thy statutes. ז ZAYIN.

units.leftText: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
units.rightText: Remember the word unto thy servant, Because thou hast made me to hope.

units.leftText: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
units.rightText: This is my comfort in my affliction; For thy word hath quickened me.

units.leftText: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
units.rightText: The proud have had me greatly in derision: Yet have I not swerved from thy law.

units.leftText: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
units.rightText: I have remembered thine ordinances of old, O Jehovah, And have comforted myself.

units.leftText: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
units.rightText: Hot indignation hath taken hold upon me, Because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

units.leftText: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
units.rightText: Thy statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.

units.leftText: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
units.rightText: I have remembered thy name, O Jehovah, in the night, And have observed thy law.

units.leftText: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts. ח HETH
units.rightText: This I have had, Because I have kept thy precepts. ח HHETH.

units.leftText: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
units.rightText: Jehovah is my portion: I have said that I would observe thy words.

units.leftText: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
units.rightText: I entreated thy favor with my whole heart: Be merciful unto me according to thy word.

units.leftText: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
units.rightText: I thought on my ways, And turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

units.leftText: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
units.rightText: I made haste, and delayed not, To observe thy commandments.

units.leftText: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
units.rightText: The cords of the wicked have wrapped me round; But I have not forgotten thy law.

units.leftText: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
units.rightText: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee Because of thy righteous ordinances.

units.leftText: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
units.rightText: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, And of them that observe thy precepts.

units.leftText: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes. ט TETH
units.rightText: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes. ט TETH.

units.leftText: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
units.rightText: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.

units.leftText: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
units.rightText: Teach me good judgment and knowledge; For I have believed in thy commandments.

units.leftText: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
units.rightText: Before I was afflicted I went astray; But now I observe thy word.

units.leftText: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
units.rightText: Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me thy statutes.

units.leftText: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
units.rightText: The proud have forged a lie against me: With my whole heart will I keep thy precepts.

units.leftText: Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.
units.rightText: Their heart is as fat as grease; But I delight in thy law.
leftNotes: 119:70 Or fat

units.leftText: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
units.rightText: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; That I may learn thy statutes.

units.leftText: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. י YODH
units.rightText: The law of thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver. י YODH.

units.leftText: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
units.rightText: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: Give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

units.leftText: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
units.rightText: They that fear thee shall see me and be glad, Because I have hoped in thy word.

units.leftText: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
units.rightText: I know, O Jehovah, that thy judgments are righteous, And that in faithfulness thou hast afflicted me.

units.leftText: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
units.rightText: Let, I pray thee, thy lovingkindness be for my comfort, According to thy word unto thy servant.

units.leftText: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
units.rightText: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; For thy law is my delight.

units.leftText: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
units.rightText: Let the proud be put to shame; for they have overthrown me wrongfully: But I will meditate on thy precepts.

units.leftText: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
units.rightText: Let those that fear thee turn unto me; And they shall know thy testimonies.

units.leftText: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame. כ KAPH
units.rightText: Let my heart be perfect in thy statutes, That I be not put to shame. כ KAPH.

units.leftText: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
units.rightText: My soul fainteth for thy salvation; But I hope in thy word.

units.leftText: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
units.rightText: Mine eyes fail for thy word, While I say, When wilt thou comfort me?

units.leftText: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
units.rightText: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.

units.leftText: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
units.rightText: How many are the days of thy servant? When wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
leftNotes: 119:84 Or How many are the days of Your servant?

units.leftText: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
units.rightText: The proud have digged pits for me, Who are not according to thy law.

units.leftText: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause— help me!
units.rightText: All thy commandments are faithful: They persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

units.leftText: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
units.rightText: They had almost consumed me upon earth; But I forsook not thy precepts.

units.leftText: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth. ל LAMEDH
units.rightText: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth. ל LAMEDH.

units.leftText: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
units.rightText: For ever, O Jehovah, Thy word is settled in heaven.

units.leftText: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
units.rightText: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: Thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

units.leftText: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
units.rightText: They abide this day according to thine ordinances; For all things are thy servants.
leftNotes: 119:91 Or They stand this day according to Your ordinances

units.leftText: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
units.rightText: Unless thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

units.leftText: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
units.rightText: I will never forget thy precepts; For with them thou hast quickened me.

units.leftText: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
units.rightText: I am thine, save me; For I have sought thy precepts.

units.leftText: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
units.rightText: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me; But I will consider thy testimonies.

units.leftText: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit. מ MEM
units.rightText: I have seen an end of all perfection; But thy commandment is exceeding broad. מ MEM.

units.leftText: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
units.rightText: Oh how love I thy law! It is my meditation all the day.

units.leftText: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
units.rightText: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies; For they are ever with me.

units.leftText: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
units.rightText: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For thy testimonies are my meditation.

units.leftText: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
units.rightText: I understand more than the aged, Because I have kept thy precepts.

units.leftText: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
units.rightText: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, That I might observe thy word.

units.leftText: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
units.rightText: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances; For thou hast taught me.

units.leftText: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
units.rightText: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

units.leftText: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way. נ NUN
units.rightText: Through thy precepts I get understanding: Therefore I hate every false way. נ NUN.

units.leftText: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
units.rightText: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And light unto my path.

units.leftText: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
units.rightText: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, That I will observe thy righteous ordinances.

units.leftText: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
units.rightText: I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.

units.leftText: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
units.rightText: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me thine ordinances.

units.leftText: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
units.rightText: My soul is continually in my hand; Yet do I not forget thy law.

units.leftText: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
units.rightText: The wicked have laid a snare for me; Yet have I not gone astray from thy precepts.

units.leftText: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
units.rightText: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; For they are the rejoicing of my heart.

units.leftText: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end. ס SAMEKH
units.rightText: I have inclined my heart to perform thy statutes For ever, even unto the end. ס SAMEKH.

units.leftText: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
units.rightText: I hate them that are of a double mind; But thy law do I love.

units.leftText: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
units.rightText: Thou art my hiding-place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

units.leftText: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
units.rightText: Depart from me, ye evil-doers, That I may keep the commandments of my God.

units.leftText: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
units.rightText: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live; And let me not be ashamed of my hope.

units.leftText: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
units.rightText: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe, And shall have respect unto thy statutes continually.

units.leftText: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
units.rightText: Thou hast set at nought all them that err from thy statutes; For their deceit is falsehood.

units.leftText: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
units.rightText: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: Therefore I love thy testimonies.

units.leftText: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments. ע AYIN
units.rightText: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; And I am afraid of thy judgments. ע AYIN.

units.leftText: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
units.rightText: I have done justice and righteousness: Leave me not to mine oppressors.

units.leftText: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
units.rightText: Be surety for thy servant for good: Let not the proud oppress me.

units.leftText: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
units.rightText: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, And for thy righteous word.

units.leftText: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
units.rightText: Deal with thy servant according unto thy lovingkindness, And teach me thy statutes.

units.leftText: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
units.rightText: I am thy servant; give me understanding, That I may know thy testimonies.

units.leftText: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
units.rightText: It is time for Jehovah to work; For they have made void thy law.

units.leftText: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
units.rightText: Therefore I love thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.

units.leftText: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way. פ PE
units.rightText: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; And I hate every false way. פ PE.

units.leftText: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
units.rightText: Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.

units.leftText: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
units.rightText: The opening of thy words giveth light; It giveth understanding unto the simple.

units.leftText: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
units.rightText: I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for thy commandments.

units.leftText: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
units.rightText: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me, As thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

units.leftText: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
units.rightText: Establish my footsteps in thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

units.leftText: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
units.rightText: Redeem me from the oppression of man: So will I observe thy precepts.

units.leftText: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
units.rightText: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; And teach me thy statutes.

units.leftText: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed. צ TZADE
units.rightText: Streams of water run down mine eyes, Because they observe not thy law. צ TSADHE.

units.leftText: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
units.rightText: Righteous art thou, O Jehovah, And upright are thy judgments.

units.leftText: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
units.rightText: Thou hast commanded thy testimonies in righteousness And very faithfulness.

units.leftText: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
units.rightText: My zeal hath consumed me, Because mine adversaries have forgotten thy words.

units.leftText: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
units.rightText: Thy word is very pure; Therefore thy servant loveth it.

units.leftText: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
units.rightText: I am small and despised; Yet do I not forget thy precepts.

units.leftText: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
units.rightText: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And thy law is truth.

units.leftText: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
units.rightText: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me; Yet thy commandments are my delight.

units.leftText: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. ק KOPH
units.rightText: Thy testimonies are righteous for ever: Give me understanding, and I shall live. ק QOPH.

units.leftText: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
units.rightText: I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O Jehovah: I will keep thy statutes.

units.leftText: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
units.rightText: I have called unto thee; save me, And I shall observe thy testimonies.

units.leftText: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
units.rightText: I anticipated the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy words.

units.leftText: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
units.rightText: Mine eyes anticipated the night-watches, That I might meditate on thy word.

units.leftText: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
units.rightText: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thine ordinances.

units.leftText: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
units.rightText: They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; They are far from thy law.

units.leftText: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
units.rightText: Thou art nigh, O Jehovah; And all thy commandments are truth.

units.leftText: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever. ר RESH
units.rightText: Of old have I known from thy testimonies, That thou hast founded them for ever. ר RESH.

units.leftText: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
units.rightText: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me; For I do not forget thy law.

units.leftText: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
units.rightText: Plead thou my cause, and redeem me: Quicken me according to thy word.

units.leftText: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
units.rightText: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not thy statutes.

units.leftText: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
units.rightText: Great are thy tender mercies, O Jehovah: Quicken me according to thine ordinances.

units.leftText: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
units.rightText: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yet have I not swerved from thy testimonies.

units.leftText: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
units.rightText: I beheld the treacherous, and was grieved, Because they observe not thy word.

units.leftText: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
units.rightText: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.

units.leftText: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever. ש SIN and SHIN
units.rightText: The sum of thy word is truth; And every one of thy righteous ordinances endureth for ever. ש SHIN.

units.leftText: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
units.rightText: Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of thy words.

units.leftText: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
units.rightText: I rejoice at thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.

units.leftText: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
units.rightText: I hate and abhor falsehood; But thy law do I love.

units.leftText: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
units.rightText: Seven times a day do I praise thee, Because of thy righteous ordinances.

units.leftText: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
units.rightText: Great peace have they that love thy law; And they have no occasion of stumbling.

units.leftText: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
units.rightText: I have hoped for thy salvation, O Jehovah, And have done thy commandments.

units.leftText: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
units.rightText: My soul hath observed thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.

units.leftText: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You. ת TAW
units.rightText: I have observed thy precepts and thy testimonies; For all my ways are before thee. ת TAV.

units.leftText: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
units.rightText: Let my cry come near before thee, O Jehovah: Give me understanding according to thy word.

units.leftText: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
units.rightText: Let my supplication come before thee: Deliver me according to thy word.

units.leftText: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
units.rightText: Let my lips utter praise; For thou teachest me thy statutes.

units.leftText: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
units.rightText: Let my tongue sing of thy word; For all thy commandments are righteousness.

units.leftText: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
units.rightText: Let thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen thy precepts.

units.leftText: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
units.rightText: I have longed for thy salvation, O Jehovah; And thy law is my delight.

units.leftText: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
units.rightText: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; And let thine ordinances help me.

units.leftText: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
units.rightText: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; For I do not forget thy commandments.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
units.rightText: In my distress I cried unto Jehovah, And he answered me.

units.leftText: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
units.rightText: Deliver my soul, O Jehovah, from lying lips, And from a deceitful tongue.

units.leftText: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
units.rightText: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?

units.leftText: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
units.rightText: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of juniper.

units.leftText: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
units.rightText: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Meshech, That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

units.leftText: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
units.rightText: My soul hath long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.

units.leftText: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
units.rightText: I am for peace: But when I speak, they are for war.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
units.rightText: I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?

units.leftText: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
units.rightText: My help cometh from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

units.leftText: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
units.rightText: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

units.leftText: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
units.rightText: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.

units.leftText: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
units.rightText: Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.

units.leftText: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
units.rightText: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.

units.leftText: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
units.rightText: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.

units.leftText: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
units.rightText: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
units.rightText: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
units.rightText: Our feet are standing Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,

units.leftText: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
units.rightText: Jerusalem, that art builded As a city that is compact together;

units.leftText: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
units.rightText: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, For an ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.

units.leftText: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
units.rightText: For there are set thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.

units.leftText: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
units.rightText: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.
leftNotes: 122:6 Or be secure

units.leftText: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
units.rightText: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.
leftNotes: 122:7 Or security

units.leftText: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
units.rightText: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

units.leftText: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
units.rightText: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
units.rightText: Unto thee do I lift up mine eyes, O thou that sittest in the heavens.

units.leftText: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
units.rightText: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maid unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes look unto Jehovah our God, Until he have mercy upon us.

units.leftText: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
units.rightText: Have mercy upon us, O Jehovah, have mercy upon us; For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

units.leftText: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
units.rightText: Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scoffing of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—
units.rightText: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, Let Israel now say,

units.leftText: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
units.rightText: If it had not been Jehovah who was on our side, When men rose up against us;

units.leftText: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
units.rightText: Then they had swallowed us up alive, When their wrath was kindled against us:

units.leftText: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
units.rightText: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, The stream had gone over our soul;

units.leftText: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
units.rightText: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah, Who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

units.leftText: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
units.rightText: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

units.leftText: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
units.rightText: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
units.rightText: They that trust in Jehovah Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.

units.leftText: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
units.rightText: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So Jehovah is round about his people From this time forth and for evermore.
