units.leftText: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
units.rightText: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.

units.leftText: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
units.rightText: Do good, O Jehovah, unto those that are good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.

units.leftText: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
units.rightText: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
units.rightText: When Jehovah brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.
leftNotes: 126:1 Or brought back the captives to Zion or restored the fortunes of Zion
126:1 Or like those restored to health

units.leftText: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
units.rightText: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing: Then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.

units.leftText: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath done great things for us, Whereof we are glad.

units.leftText: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
units.rightText: Turn again our captivity, O Jehovah, As the streams in the South.
leftNotes: 126:4 Or Restore our fortunes

units.leftText: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
units.rightText: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

units.leftText: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
units.rightText: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with joy, bringing his sheaves with him.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
units.rightText: Except Jehovah build the house, They labor in vain that build it: Except Jehovah keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.

units.leftText: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat — for He gives sleep to His beloved.
units.rightText: It is vain for you to rise up early, To take rest late, To eat the bread of toil; For so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.

units.leftText: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
units.rightText: Lo, children are a heritage of Jehovah; And the fruit of the womb is his reward.

units.leftText: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
units.rightText: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of youth.

units.leftText: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
units.rightText: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
units.rightText: Blessed is every one that feareth Jehovah, That walketh in his ways.

units.leftText: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
units.rightText: For thou shalt eat the labor of thy hands: Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

units.leftText: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
units.rightText: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, In the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, Round about thy table.

units.leftText: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
units.rightText: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed That feareth Jehovah.

units.leftText: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
units.rightText: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion: And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

units.leftText: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
units.rightText: Yea, see thou thy children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—
units.rightText: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up, Let Israel now say,

units.leftText: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
units.rightText: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.

units.leftText: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
units.rightText: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.

units.leftText: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
units.rightText: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

units.leftText: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
units.rightText: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.

units.leftText: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
units.rightText: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it groweth up;

units.leftText: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
units.rightText: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves, his bosom:

units.leftText: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
units.rightText: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; We bless you in the name of Jehovah.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
units.rightText: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Jehovah.

units.leftText: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
units.rightText: Lord, hear my voice: Let thine ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.

units.leftText: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
units.rightText: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?

units.leftText: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
units.rightText: But there is forgiveness with thee, That thou mayest be feared.

units.leftText: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
units.rightText: I wait for Jehovah, my soul doth wait, And in his word do I hope.

units.leftText: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.
units.rightText: My soul waiteth for the Lord More than watchmen wait for the morning; Yea, more than watchmen for the morning.

units.leftText: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
units.rightText: O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.

units.leftText: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
units.rightText: And he will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
units.rightText: Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in great matters, Or in things too wonderful for me.

units.leftText: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
units.rightText: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother, Like a weaned child is my soul within me.

units.leftText: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
units.rightText: O Israel, hope in Jehovah From this time forth and for evermore.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
units.rightText: Jehovah, remember for David All his affliction;

units.leftText: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
units.rightText: How he sware unto Jehovah, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

units.leftText: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
units.rightText: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, Nor go up into my bed;

units.leftText: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
units.rightText: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Or slumber to mine eyelids;

units.leftText: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob. ”
units.rightText: Until I find out a place for Jehovah, A tabernacle for the Mighty One of Jacob.
leftNotes: 132:5 LXX for the God of Jacob; see Acts 7:46|ACT 7:46*.

units.leftText: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
units.rightText: Lo, we heard of it in Ephrathah: We found it in the field of the wood.
leftNotes: 132:6 Literally Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah

units.leftText: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
units.rightText: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.

units.leftText: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
units.rightText: Arise, O Jehovah, into thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of thy strength.

units.leftText: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
units.rightText: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let thy saints shout for joy.

units.leftText: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
units.rightText: For thy servant David’s sake Turn not away the face of thine anointed.

units.leftText: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath sworn unto David in truth; He will not turn from it: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
leftNotes: 132:11 Literally “From the fruit of your body I will set (one) on your throne.Cited in Acts 2:30|ACT 2:30*

units.leftText: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
units.rightText: If thy children will keep my covenant And my testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also shall sit upon thy throne for evermore.

units.leftText: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
units.rightText: For Jehovah hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for his habitation.

units.leftText: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
units.rightText: This is my resting-place for ever: Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

units.leftText: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
units.rightText: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

units.leftText: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
units.rightText: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

units.leftText: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
units.rightText: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

units.leftText: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
units.rightText: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown flourish.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
units.rightText: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!

units.leftText: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
units.rightText: It is like the precious oil upon the head, That ran down upon the beard, Even Aaron’s beard; That came down upon the skirt of his garments;

units.leftText: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
units.rightText: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion: For there Jehovah commanded the blessing, Even life for evermore.

units.leftText: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
units.rightText: Behold, bless ye Jehovah, all ye servants of Jehovah, That by night stand in the house of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
units.rightText: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye Jehovah.

units.leftText: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
units.rightText: Jehovah bless thee out of Zion; Even he that made heaven and earth.

units.leftText: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise him, O ye servants of Jehovah,
leftNotes: 135:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verses 3 and 21

units.leftText: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
units.rightText: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.

units.leftText: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good: Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

units.leftText: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
units.rightText: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, And Israel for his own possession.

units.leftText: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
units.rightText: For I know that Jehovah is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.

units.leftText: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
units.rightText: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

units.leftText: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
units.rightText: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; Who maketh lightnings for the rain; Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;

units.leftText: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
units.rightText: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast;

units.leftText: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
units.rightText: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;

units.leftText: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
units.rightText: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,

units.leftText: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
units.rightText: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan,

units.leftText: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
units.rightText: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.

units.leftText: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
units.rightText: Thy name, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Thy memorial name, O Jehovah, throughout all generations.

units.leftText: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
units.rightText: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself concerning his servants.
leftNotes: 135:14 Or will judge His people; see also LXX; cited in Hebrews 10:30|HEB 10:30*.

units.leftText: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
units.rightText: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.

units.leftText: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
units.rightText: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

units.leftText: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
units.rightText: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.

units.leftText: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
units.rightText: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

units.leftText: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
units.rightText: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:

units.leftText: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
units.rightText: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.

units.leftText: Blessed be the LORD from Zion — He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto Jehovah; for he is good; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto the God of gods; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto the Lord of lords; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: To him who alone doeth great wonders; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: To him that by understanding made the heavens; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: To him that spread forth the earth above the waters; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: He made the great lights — His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: To him that made great lights; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: The sun to rule by day; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

units.leftText: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: The moon and stars to rule by night; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: To him that smote Egypt in their first-born; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

units.leftText: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: And brought out Israel from among them; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

units.leftText: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: To him that divided the Red Sea in sunder; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;
leftNotes: 136:13 Or the Sea of Reeds; also in verse 15

units.leftText: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

units.leftText: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:
leftNotes: 136:15 Hebrew shook off

units.leftText: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: To him that led his people through the wilderness; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: To him that smote great kings; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

units.leftText: and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: And slew famous kings; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Sihon king of the Amorites; For his lovingkindness endureth forever;

units.leftText: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: And Og king of Bashan; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

units.leftText: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: And gave their land for a heritage; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

units.leftText: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Even a heritage unto Israel his servant; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Who remembered us in our low estate; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever;

units.leftText: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: And hath delivered us from our adversaries; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever:

units.leftText: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Who giveth food to all flesh; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
units.rightText: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.

units.leftText: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
units.rightText: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.

units.leftText: There on the willows we hung our harps,
units.rightText: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.
leftNotes: 137:2 Or poplars

units.leftText: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”
units.rightText: For there they that led us captive required of us songs, And they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

units.leftText: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?
units.rightText: How shall we sing Jehovah’s song In a foreign land?

units.leftText: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.
units.rightText: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget her skill.

units.leftText: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!
units.rightText: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I prefer not Jerusalem Above my chief joy.

units.leftText: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
units.rightText: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.

units.leftText: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
units.rightText: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.

units.leftText: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
units.rightText: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.

units.leftText: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
units.rightText: I will give thee thanks with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.

units.leftText: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
units.rightText: I will worship toward thy holy temple, And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

units.leftText: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
units.rightText: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.
leftNotes: 138:3 Or You emboldened me with strength in my soul

units.leftText: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
units.rightText: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.

units.leftText: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
units.rightText: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah; For great is the glory of Jehovah.

units.leftText: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
units.rightText: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.

units.leftText: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
units.rightText: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand will save me.

units.leftText: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever — do not abandon the works of Your hands.
units.rightText: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, thou hast searched me, and known me.

units.leftText: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
units.rightText: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising; Thou understandest my thought afar off.

units.leftText: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
units.rightText: Thou searchest out my path and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.

units.leftText: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
units.rightText: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O Jehovah, thou knowest it altogether.

units.leftText: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
units.rightText: Thou hast beset me behind and before, And laid thy hand upon me.

units.leftText: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
units.rightText: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain unto it.

units.leftText: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
units.rightText: Whither shall I go from thy Spirit? Or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

units.leftText: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
units.rightText: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, thou art there.

units.leftText: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
units.rightText: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

units.leftText: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
units.rightText: Even there shall thy hand lead me, And thy right hand shall hold me.

units.leftText: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
units.rightText: If I say, Surely the darkness shall overwhelm me, And the light about me shall be night;

units.leftText: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
units.rightText: Even the darkness hideth not from thee, But the night shineth as the day: The darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

units.leftText: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
units.rightText: For thou didst form my inward parts: Thou didst cover me in my mother’s womb.
leftNotes: 139:13 Hebrew my kidneys

units.leftText: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
units.rightText: I will give thanks unto thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: Wonderful are thy works; And that my soul knoweth right well.

units.leftText: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
units.rightText: My frame was not hidden from thee, When I was made in secret, And curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

units.leftText: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
units.rightText: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance; And in thy book they were all written, Even the days that were ordained for me, When as yet there was none of them.

units.leftText: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
units.rightText: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!
leftNotes: 139:17 Or How amazing are Your thoughts concerning me

units.leftText: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
units.rightText: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: When I awake, I am still with thee.

units.leftText: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
units.rightText: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: Depart from me therefore, ye bloodthirsty men.

units.leftText: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
units.rightText: For they speak against thee wickedly, And thine enemies take thy name in vain.
leftNotes: 139:20 Hebrew Your enemies take in vain or Your enemies bear up in vain; LXX Your enemies take Your cities in vain

units.leftText: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
units.rightText: Do not I hate them, O Jehovah, that hate thee? And am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

units.leftText: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
units.rightText: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.

units.leftText: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
units.rightText: Search me, O God, and know my heart: Try me, and know my thoughts;

units.leftText: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
units.rightText: And see if there be any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.

units.leftText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
units.rightText: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man:

units.leftText: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
units.rightText: Who devise mischiefs in their heart; Continually do they gather themselves together for war.

units.leftText: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
units.rightText: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Adders’ poison is under their lips. [Selah*
leftNotes: 140:3 Cited in Romans 3:13|ROM 3:13*

units.leftText: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
units.rightText: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.

units.leftText: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
units.rightText: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. [Selah*

units.leftText: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
units.rightText: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God: Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.

units.leftText: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
units.rightText: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

units.leftText: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
units.rightText: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, lest they exalt themselves. [Selah*

units.leftText: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
units.rightText: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

units.leftText: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
units.rightText: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.

units.leftText: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
units.rightText: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

units.leftText: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
units.rightText: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.

units.leftText: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
units.rightText: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
units.rightText: Jehovah, I have called upon thee; make haste unto me: Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto thee.

units.leftText: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.
units.rightText: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before thee; The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

units.leftText: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
units.rightText: Set a watch, O Jehovah, before my mouth; Keep the door of my lips.

units.leftText: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
units.rightText: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To practise deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity: And let me not eat of their dainties.

units.leftText: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
units.rightText: Let the righteous smite me, it shall be a kindness; And let him reprove me, it shall be as oil upon the head; Let not my head refuse it: For even in their wickedness shall my prayer continue.

units.leftText: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.
units.rightText: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

units.leftText: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
units.rightText: As when one ploweth and cleaveth the earth, Our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.

units.leftText: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
units.rightText: For mine eyes are unto thee, O Jehovah the Lord: In thee do I take refuge; leave not my soul destitute.
leftNotes: 141:8 Or do not pour out my life or do not give me over to death

units.leftText: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
units.rightText: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.

units.leftText: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
units.rightText: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst that I withal escape.

units.leftText: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
units.rightText: I cry with my voice unto Jehovah; With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.
leftNotes: 142:1 Maskil is probably a musical or liturgical term; used for Psalms 32, 42, 44–45, 52–55, 74, 78, 88–89, and 142.

units.leftText: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
units.rightText: I pour out my complaint before him; I show before him my trouble.

units.leftText: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
units.rightText: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.

units.leftText: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
units.rightText: Look on my right hand, and see; For there is no man that knoweth me: Refuge hath failed me; No man careth for my soul.

units.leftText: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
units.rightText: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.

units.leftText: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
units.rightText: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.

units.leftText: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
units.rightText: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me.

units.leftText: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
units.rightText: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

units.leftText: Do not bring Your servant into judgment, for no one alive is righteous before You.
units.rightText: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; For in thy sight no man living is righteous.

units.leftText: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
units.rightText: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

units.leftText: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
units.rightText: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.

units.leftText: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
units.rightText: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy doings; I muse on the work of thy hands.

units.leftText: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
units.rightText: I spread forth my hands unto thee: My soul thirsteth after thee, as a weary land. [Selah*

units.leftText: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
units.rightText: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.

units.leftText: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
units.rightText: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.

units.leftText: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
units.rightText: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
leftNotes: 143:9 LXX and one Hebrew manuscript; most Hebrew manuscripts in You I take cover

units.leftText: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God. May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground.
units.rightText: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.

units.leftText: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
units.rightText: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name’s sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.

units.leftText: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
units.rightText: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant.

units.leftText: Of David. Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
units.rightText: Blessed be Jehovah my rock, Who teacheth my hands to war, And my fingers to fight:

units.leftText: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
units.rightText: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and he in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.
leftNotes: 144:2 Many Hebrew manuscripts, DSS, Syriac; most Hebrew manuscripts subdues my people

units.leftText: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
units.rightText: Jehovah, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

units.leftText: Man is like a breath; his days are like a passing shadow.
units.rightText: Man is like to vanity: His days are as a shadow that passeth away.

units.leftText: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
units.rightText: Bow thy heavens, O Jehovah, and come down: Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

units.leftText: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
units.rightText: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out thine arrows, and discomfit them.

units.leftText: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
units.rightText: Stretch forth thy hand from above; Rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, Out of the hand of aliens;

units.leftText: whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
units.rightText: Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

units.leftText: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You —
units.rightText: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

units.leftText: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
units.rightText: Thou art he that giveth salvation unto kings; Who rescueth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

units.leftText: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
units.rightText: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of aliens, Whose mouth speaketh deceit, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

units.leftText: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
units.rightText: When our sons shall be as plants grown up in their youth, And our daughters as corner-stones hewn after the fashion of a palace;

units.leftText: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.
units.rightText: When our garners are full, affording all manner of store, And our sheep bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our fields;

units.leftText: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.
units.rightText: When our oxen are well laden; When there is no breaking in, and no going forth, And no outcry in our streets:
leftNotes: 144:14 Or Our chieftains will be firmly established

units.leftText: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
units.rightText: Happy is the people that is in such a case; Yea, happy is the people whose God is Jehovah.

units.leftText: A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
units.rightText: I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
leftNotes: 145:1 This psalm is an acrostic poem, each verse beginning with the successive letters of the Hebrew alphabet.

units.leftText: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
units.rightText: Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

units.leftText: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
units.rightText: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.

units.leftText: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
units.rightText: One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.

units.leftText: the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
units.rightText: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.

units.leftText: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
units.rightText: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts; And I will declare thy greatness.

units.leftText: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
units.rightText: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
units.rightText: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.

units.leftText: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
units.rightText: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.

units.leftText: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
units.rightText: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; And thy saints shall bless thee.

units.leftText: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might,
units.rightText: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;

units.leftText: to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
units.rightText: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

units.leftText: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
units.rightText: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
leftNotes: 145:13 The final two lines are supplied by one MT manuscript, LXX, Syriac, and DSS.

units.leftText: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
units.rightText: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.

units.leftText: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
units.rightText: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.

units.leftText: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
units.rightText: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

units.leftText: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
units.rightText: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, And gracious in all his works.

units.leftText: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
units.rightText: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.

units.leftText: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
units.rightText: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him; He also will hear their cry and will save them.

units.leftText: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
units.rightText: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him; But all the wicked will he destroy.

units.leftText: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.
units.rightText: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

units.leftText: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise Jehovah, O my soul.
leftNotes: 146:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 10

units.leftText: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
units.rightText: While I live will I praise Jehovah: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

units.leftText: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
units.rightText: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

units.leftText: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
units.rightText: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; In that very day his thoughts perish.

units.leftText: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
units.rightText: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God:

units.leftText: the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.
units.rightText: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;

units.leftText: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
units.rightText: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth food to the hungry. Jehovah looseth the prisoners;

units.leftText: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
units.rightText: Jehovah openeth the eyes of the blind; Jehovah raiseth up them that are bowed down; Jehovah loveth the righteous;

units.leftText: The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
units.rightText: Jehovah preserveth the sojourners; He upholdeth the fatherless and widow; But the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

units.leftText: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: Jehovah will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye Jehovah.

units.leftText: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely.
leftNotes: 147:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 20

units.leftText: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
units.rightText: Jehovah doth build up Jerusalem; He gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

units.leftText: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
units.rightText: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.

units.leftText: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
units.rightText: He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by their names.

units.leftText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
units.rightText: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.

units.leftText: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
units.rightText: Jehovah upholdeth the meek: He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,
units.rightText: Sing unto Jehovah with thanksgiving; Sing praises upon the harp unto our God,

units.leftText: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
units.rightText: Who covereth the heavens with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

units.leftText: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
units.rightText: He giveth to the beast his food, And to the young ravens which cry.

units.leftText: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
units.rightText: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.

units.leftText: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
units.rightText: Jehovah taketh pleasure in them that fear him, In those that hope in his lovingkindness.

units.leftText: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
units.rightText: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.

units.leftText: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.
units.rightText: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.

units.leftText: He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
units.rightText: He maketh peace in thy borders; He filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

units.leftText: He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
units.rightText: He sendeth out his commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.

units.leftText: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
units.rightText: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.

units.leftText: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
units.rightText: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: Who can stand before his cold?
leftNotes: 147:17 Or like crumbs or like morsels

units.leftText: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
units.rightText: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: He causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

units.leftText: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
units.rightText: He showeth his word unto Jacob, His statutes and his ordinances unto Israel.

units.leftText: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for his ordinances, they have not known them. Praise ye Jehovah.
leftNotes: 147:20 MT; DSS and LXX He has not made known to them His judgments

units.leftText: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah from the heavens: Praise him in the heights.
leftNotes: 148:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 14
148:1 See Matthew 21:9|MAT 21:9*, Mark 11:10, and Luke 19:38.

units.leftText: Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His heavenly hosts.
units.rightText: Praise ye him, all his angels: Praise ye him, all his host.

units.leftText: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
units.rightText: Praise ye him, sun and moon: Praise him, all ye stars of light.

units.leftText: Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
units.rightText: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.

units.leftText: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for He gave the command and they were created.
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he commanded, and they were created.

units.leftText: He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
units.rightText: He hath also established them for ever and ever: He hath made a decree which shall not pass away.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
units.rightText: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;

units.leftText: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
units.rightText: Fire and hail, snow and vapor; Stormy wind, fulfilling his word;

units.leftText: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
units.rightText: Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;

units.leftText: wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
units.rightText: Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying birds;

units.leftText: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,
units.rightText: Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;

units.leftText: young men and maidens, old and young together.
units.rightText: Both young men and virgins; Old men and children:

units.leftText: Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
units.rightText: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For his name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

units.leftText: He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: And he hath lifted up the horn of his people, The praise of all his saints; Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye Jehovah.

units.leftText: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song — His praise in the assembly of the godly.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. Sing unto Jehovah a new song, And his praise in the assembly of the saints.
leftNotes: 149:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 9

units.leftText: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
units.rightText: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

units.leftText: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
units.rightText: Let them praise his name in the dance: Let them sing praises unto him with timbrel and harp.

units.leftText: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
units.rightText: For Jehovah taketh pleasure in his people: He will beautify the meek with salvation.

units.leftText: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
units.rightText: Let the saints exult in glory: Let them sing for joy upon their beds.

units.leftText: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,
units.rightText: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;

units.leftText: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
units.rightText: To execute vengeance upon the nations, And punishments upon the peoples;

units.leftText: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron,
units.rightText: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;

units.leftText: to execute the judgment written against them. This honor is for all His saints. Hallelujah!
units.rightText: To execute upon them the judgment written: This honor have all his saints. Praise ye Jehovah.

units.leftText: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
units.rightText: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise God in his sanctuary: Praise him in the firmament of his power.
leftNotes: 150:1 Or Hallelu YAH, meaning Praise the LORD; also in verse 6
150:1 Or in the expanse of His might or in the firmament of His might; see also Genesis 1:6–8|GEN 1:6-8*.

units.leftText: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.
units.rightText: Praise him for his mighty acts: Praise him according to his excellent greatness.

units.leftText: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
units.rightText: Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.

units.leftText: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
units.rightText: Praise him with timbrel and dance: Praise him with stringed instruments and pipe.

units.leftText: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
units.rightText: Praise him with loud cymbals: Praise him with high sounding cymbals.

units.leftText: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
units.rightText: Let everything that hath breath praise Jehovah. Praise ye Jehovah.
